column122: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;
column123: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;
column124: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;
column125: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: This is where the magic happens! Right over here, let me show you this. See all these? [pets shelf of paper] You know what that is? That's paper. This is where paper comes from. Any questions?

column127: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: No, we don't actually cut the paper. That's a good question. The paper is sent to us cut, and dyed, from a paper manufacturer, and then we sell it to a business for more than we paid for it.
column128: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Abby: That's not fair. [the rest of the kids agree]
column129: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: Yes it is, well, w-w--you need someone in the middle to facilitate...
column130: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Jake: You're just a middleman.
column131: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: I'm not just a middle... man...

column134: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Dwight: We have better service than they do!
column135: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: ...There's Creed! Let's take a look at what he's doing, everybody! This is Creed, and he is in charge of... something. Right?
column136: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Creed: That is correct.

column138: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Creed: Hi kids.
column139: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: Yaaaaay.
column140: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Creed: Have you ever seen a foot with four toes? [begins untying shoe]

column142: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: What are you doing? N--stop it! Stop it! Just--no, no, no, no! No! Would you cut it out?! What is your problem?
column143: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Creed: Th-the hair covers it, mostly.
column144: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: No no no, we're not gonna see--- we're not gonna see the four toed... Creed, okay?
column145: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: You know, there's something interesting about me you might want to know. I ... used to be ... the star of a kids show.
column146: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Kids: No way.
column147: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: It's true. I did.
column148: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Melissa: You serious?
column149: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Jake: Really?
column150: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: I am totally serious. There was a show called 'Fundle Bundle' and I was the star.
column151: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Abby: That doesn't sound like a show.
column152: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Melissa: What?!
column153: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: It's true! I can prove it! I can prove it, watch this. [gets up and runs out] Ryan, can you come here a second? [clears throat] I would like you to go to my mother's house in Dickson city, and if she is in the pool, the back kitchen window should be unlocked, I want you to boost yourself up, I want you to go down to the basement. In the basement is a tape labeled 'Fundle Bundle'. I want you to grab it, I want you to get my guitar.
column154: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Ryan: Right. Okay.
column155: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: I want you to get the tambourine. Do you know how to play the tambourine?
column156: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Ryan: Um, I'm already getting the pizzas from Bernetti's, so...
column157: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Melissa: You know, I can go with him.
column158: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: Oka--
column159: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Ryan: No! I will... go.
column160: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: Okay! Thank you Ryan. Good attitude, hottest in the office.
column161: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: [to Abby] Alright, nowwww... what kind... of pizza do you like?
column162: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: I don't get why parents are always complaining about how tough it is to raise kids. You joke around with them, you give them pizza, you give them candy, you let them live their lives... They're adults, for God's sake.
column163: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: I am going to give you a little blast from the past of Michael Gary Scott when he was a child star, and a show that you might remember called 'Fundle Bundle.' Okay? Without further ado, Ryan?
column164: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Miss Trudy: [from TV] ...Bundle, are you ready to come on in? [TV children cheer] Let's have some fun!
column165: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: That... is Miss Trudy. Can't tell from the costume, but she had an amazing body. Okay, you can... fast forward. And... I want you... to...
column166: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Dwight: Is that a real fun shooting windmill?
column167: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: Stop! Stop! Stop! [Ryan resumes the tape] Yes! That is, uh, Edward R. Meow.
column168: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Jim: That's pretty funny.

column173: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Oscar: Is that Chet Montgomery?
column174: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: Uhh, I don't know.
column175: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Pam: That is!
column176: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Darryl: Checkin' in with Chet. Doppler's up.
column177: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Edward R. Meow: What do you want to be when you grow up?
column178: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Chet: I want to be on TV!
column179: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Dwight: [employees chuckle] And he is on TV now!
column180: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: Can everyone please shut up, please! So you don't miss it.

column183: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Edward R. Meow: Well what's your favorite subject at school?
column184: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Young Michael: Recess.
column185: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Edward R. Meow: Ree-cesss. So tell me, what do you want to be when you grow up?
column186: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Young Michael: I want to be married and have a hundred kids so I can have a hundred friends, and no one can say no to being my friend.
column187: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Edward R. Meow: [jaw drops, awkward pause] Uh, ah... oh, okay! Well uh, nice talking with you, Michael. Uh, back to you Miss Trudy!
column188: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Miss Trudy: Hi everyone, it's one of my favorite times of the day.
column189: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: Coulda sworn there was...

column191: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: ...uh, no.
column192: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Abby: Why not?
column193: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: Uh, just never happened.
column194: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Sasha: So, do you have any kids?
column195: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: Uh, nope.
column196: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Jake: Do you have a girlfriend?
column197: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: I do okay.
column198: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Melissa: Was Chet Montgomery cool back then?
column199: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: Yes.
column200: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Jake: Even I have a girlfriend.
column201: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: Okay! Alright, okay.
column202: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Sasha: So you didn't get to be what you wanted to be.
column203: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: ...I guess not... you know, I have a load of work to do so I am going to grab a slice of this delish pizza... and I'm going to go do my work. Bye.
column204: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Pam: He's not coming out. He won't pick up the phone.
column205: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Jim: Can't believe his mom dressed him like that, that's the real tragedy.
column206: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Roy: [wrestling with Jake] Pam! Pam! I love this guy! [laughs] Come on!

column208: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Melissa: Who? Terry?
column209: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Pam: Mmhmm.
column210: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Melissa: That woman is not my mother. That is my step-mother.
column211: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Jake: Mister Poop, I have to tell you something.
column212: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Dwight: Uh, okay. But first, that's not my name.
column213: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Jake: You're ugly.
column214: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Dwight: Well at least I'm not a horrible little latchkey kid who got suspended from school. So...
column215: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Jake: Meredith!
column216: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: [Toby knocks on door] Yeah?
column217: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Toby: I think these belong to you. [puts toys down on desk]
column218: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: Oh, that's okay, she can keep those.
column219: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Toby: Believe me, she has enough toys... she doesn't need your watch.
column220: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: Thank you.
column221: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Toby: Is everything okay?
column222: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: You have to ask me that because you work for human resources.
column223: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Toby: Uh... it's true...
column224: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: Well, sure, playing the field is great, don't get me wrong, but there's more to life than notches just on my bedpost.
column225: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Toby: Mmhmm.
column226: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: Tell me something honestly, do you... think... that it is too late for me to have kids?
column227: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Toby: Well, you need a wife first, or at least a girlfriend.
column228: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: What about...
column229: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Toby: Not Jan.
column230: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: ...Jan. Kay.
column231: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Toby: If you really want to have kids, I--- I guess you could somehow... foster parent, or something.
column232: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: ...Or biologically.
column233: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Toby: Somehow.
column234: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: Thanks, that's, no, that... that really means a lot to me. Hey, does Sasha have a godfather, because I...
column235: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Toby: Yes.
column236: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: Oh... kay.
column237: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Jake: Is it okay if I take one?
column238: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Pam: Sure.
column239: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Jake: Thank you.

column241: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Jake: Is your job hard?

column243: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Jake: Yeah!
column244: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Pam: Really?
column245: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Jake: Yeah.
column246: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Pam: Okay. Um... here it is. Don't put your fingers in there. [shreds paper] Cool huh?
column247: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Jake: That's so cool, yeah!
column248: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Pam: Yeah, I get to do this like, every week.
column249: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Jake: That's so awesome!
column250: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Pam: I know.
column251: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: Yes, it is true. I, Michael Scott, am signing up with an online dating service. Thousands of people have done it, and I am going to do it. I need a username. And... I have a great one [types]. Little kid lover. That way, people will know exactly where my priorities are at.
column252: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Kevin: Go ahead.
column253: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Abby: Do you want to come over for dinner tonight?
column254: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Jim: Ohh, man, I would love to! I can't tonight, but can I come over some other time? [Abby nods]
column255: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Kevin: What're you doing? You never have plans.
column256: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Jim: Thanks, Kev. Uhm... I'm actually going on a date.
column257: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Kevin: Niiice.
column258: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: Hey, uh, no, please? You can't leave yet. There's still one more thing we need to do.
column259: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: [singing] You... who are on the road... must have a code... that you can live by... [Dwight joins in] and so... become yourself... because the past... is just a goodbye... and teach... your children well...
column260: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Jim: Why does he own a guitar if he doesn't know how to play?
column261: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Pam: I think he thought his ukulele skills would transfer. [Jim leaves]
column262: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael and Dwight: [singing] ...did slowly go by... and feed... them on your dreams...
column263: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Pam: My theory is that... [Jim signals he's leaving, waves bye to Pam]
column264: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael and Dwight: [singing] ...The one they picked... the one you'll know by... don't you ever ask them why... if I told you would cry... you never look at them and sigh... and know they love you...
column265: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Dwight: And they do, your parents, love you very much.
column266: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Michael: One more time. [singing] You...
column267: 02x18 - Take Your Daughter to Work Day;Dwight: The Schrutes consider children very valuable. In the olden days, the women would bear many children, so we would have enough laborers to work the fields. And if it was an especially cold winter, and there weren't enough grains or vegetables, they would eat the weakest of the brood. [Laughs] They didn't eat the children.

column5: 02x19 - Michael's Birthday;Michael: You know what? That's a nice attitude, Ryan, I'm just helping you invest in your future, my friend.

column9: 03x03 - The Coup;Pam: Movie Monday started with training videos, but we went through those pretty fast. Then we watched a medical video. Since then, it's been half hour installments of various movies, with the exception of an episode of Entourage, which Michael made us watch six times.

column16: 03x03 - The Coup;Kevin: Ok. Billy-Bob, got a head injury, but coach made him play. So then Lance, he gets sacked, he's out for the year...
column17: 03x03 - The Coup;Jan: [walking into an empty office because everyone is watching Varsity Blues] Hello?
column18: 03x03 - The Coup;Dwight: Not everyone approves of Movie Monday. I won't say who.

column21: 03x03 - The Coup;Michael: [Jan walks in on Movie Monday] Hi Jan! Hope you brought the Milk Duds!

column23: 03x03 - The Coup;Michael: People work faster after...
column24: 03x03 - The Coup;Jan: Magically?
column25: 03x03 - The Coup;Michael: No... they have to... to make up for the time they lost watching the movie.
column26: 03x03 - The Coup;Jan: No.
column27: 03x03 - The Coup;Angela: [walking past Dwight's desk] Kitchen.
column28: 03x03 - The Coup;Angela: Michael is going to get us all fired. You sat back and let him play that dumb movie, and now Jan is peeved off and we're all going to lose our jobs.
column29: 03x03 - The Coup;Dwight: That's not going to happen.
column30: 03x03 - The Coup;Angela: You know she has it out for him now.
column31: 03x03 - The Coup;Dwight: That's not his fault! He had to follow his heart!
column32: 03x03 - The Coup;Dwight: Ever since Michael dumped Jan for Carol, Jan's been bitching out on him. Reject a woman and she will never let it go. One of the many defects of their kind. Also weak arms.
column33: 03x03 - The Coup;Angela: Dwight, you should be running this office.
column34: 03x03 - The Coup;Dwight: Michael would never let me...
column35: 03x03 - The Coup;Angela: It's not up to Michael, it's Jan's call. Talk to her.
column36: 03x03 - The Coup;Dwight: I could never do that!
column37: 03x03 - The Coup;Angela: Fine! Sit back and do nothing and let us all get fired!
column38: 03x03 - The Coup;Angela: I know that patience and loyalty are good, and virtuous traits. But sometimes I just think you need to grow a pair.
column39: 03x03 - The Coup;Jim: At the Stamford branch, they all play this World War II video game called Call of Duty, and they're all really into it. column88: 03x03 - The Coup;Jan: What would you do differently?

column175: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Jan: [looks around, noticing that no one is working] Wha... what's going on here?
column176: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Phyllis: We know the branch is closing; Michael told us.
column177: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Jan: Ah, god. Okay. You know what everybody? I'm sure there is a better way to do this but I've drive something like 400 miles today and I'm completely exhausted so I'm just gonna tell you. Your branch is not closing; Stamford is closing. Um, for the time being, it seems that all your jobs are safe.
column178: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Angela: Yes!
column179: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Kevin: Yes! [hugs Angela]
column180: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Phyllis: Stanley! [hugs Stanley]
column181: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Pam: Is it because of Michael? Did he actually do something?
column182: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Jan: Well, reasons are not important. Would you just call him, please? Wherever he is... and tell him.
column183: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Pam: Sure, uh, Jan... um, do you know, is anyone coming back to Scranton?
column184: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Jan: Back?
column185: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Pam: Coming to Scranton. Is anyone coming to Scranton?
column186: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Jan: Uh, we don't know. Probably. A few.
column187: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Dwight: [referring to Michael's ringing phone] who is it?
column188: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Michael: The office.
column189: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Dwight: Gonna get it?
column190: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Michael: No, not until I have some good news for them. Not until I have some good news.
column191: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Pam: I guess some new people might be coming from Stamford. Should be fun. New blood.
column192: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Ryan: Is Jim coming back.
column193: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Pam: That's, um... I hadn't thought about it, huh.
column194: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Ryan: I just don't want it to be weird, you know? I mean, I took his old job and his old desk.
column195: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Pam: Yeah, that might be weird. Overall though, we still all have our jobs... so, good news, right?
column196: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Ryan: Oh, yeah, totally.
column197: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Kelly: Ahhhhh! [hugs Ryan] I'm so happy we don't have to break up now, Ryan! [kisses him] This is the best day of my whole l ife!
column198: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Karen: What you gonna do?
column199: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Jim: I really don't know. How you doing with all this?
column200: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Karen: You know, I'm fine. I'll be better when I know if I have a job.
column201: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Jim: You'd actually move to Scranton?
column202: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Karen: Yeah, if they let me, I think I... I think I would.
column203: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Jim: New York City is 45 minutes down the road from here. And you wanna move to Scranton? I dunno. If I were you I'd move to New York?
column204: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Karen: Yeah, you know... I might do that. I, who knows? I... I might do that.
column205: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Josh: Hey Andy!
column206: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Andy: [after screaming and throwing papers around in the kitchen] What's up, Josh?
column207: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Josh: I just want to say thanks. Good luck.
column208: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Andy: Thanks, man. You, too. Totally.
column209: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Michael: Anything?
column210: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Dwight: Nothing. [puts down binoculars]
column211: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Michael: What if this doesn't work? What is the office actually goes under?
column212: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Dwight: Then it was an honor to have worked with you.
column213: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Michael: [pats Dwight and sighs] All right, favorite moments in Dunder-Mifflin history. Go.
column214: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Dwight: My first day when you hazed me by spraying me with a fire extinguisher.
column215: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Michael: That was hilarious. The foam ...
column216: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Dwight: Uh,... my first sale, my promotion to assistant regional manager, our basketball game, when you took me to the hospital, and told me that you cared about me.
column217: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Michael: Oh, right. Okay, that's enough. That's good.
column218: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Dwight: What were your favorite moments?
column219: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Michael: Oh, hmm, all of them. I loved them all. Every single one.
column220: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Dwight: What about when Jan said the branch was closing?
column221: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Michael: God, Dwight!
column222: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Dwight: Well, it doesn't...
column223: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Kevin: Hey Pam, we're going to Poor Richards. Creed's buying shots.
column224: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Pam: No thanks, guys.
column225: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Kevin: All right.
column226: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Pam: Have fun though.
column227: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Kevin: Cool.
column228: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Phyllis: Hey, I hear Jim's coming back.
column229: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Pam: Really? Where did you hear that?
column230: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Phyllis: I was...
column231: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Kevin: [interupting] Hey Ryan, you coming?
column232: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Ryan: Uh yeah, we'll meet you there.
column233: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Kevin: Awesome. Let's go, Phyllis.
column234: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Phyllis: [to Pam] I'll tell you later.
column235: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Pam: Okay.
column236: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Roy: Crazy day, huh?
column237: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Pam: Yeah.
column238: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Roy: Yeah, man! I'm uh... I'm really glad you're still gonna be working here.
column239: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Pam: Yeah, me too.
column240: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Pam: Maybe this is good. Finding another job is a pain. There's another annoying boss, another desk, I'd have to learn everything all over again. So, there are reasons to stay.
column241: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Jim: Hey, um, I think I am gonna take that job. And Scranton... it's not that bad. So, if they offer you a job there, I think you should take it.
column242: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Karen: Okay, yeah. Maybe I will.
column243: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Jim: Okay.
column244: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Karen: Yeah, I'm happy he said that. I mean, I don't think he's into me or anything, but, I'm kind of into him. So...there you go.
column245: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Michael: What are we still doing here? It's over. Let's go home. Get the car.
column246: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Dwight: [picks up his beeping cell phone]
column247: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Michael: Oh, this was such a stupid idea! This was so stupid. I am such a stupid idiot. I let everybody down. Everybody hates me. I lost everybody's jobs. Nobody likes me anymore!
column248: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Dwight: [on the phone] Oh my God!
column249: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Michael: What?!
column250: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Dwight:: Stranford is closed! Michael, we're not closed. Stamford is closed. Stamford is closed.
column251: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Michael: We did it? We did it.
column252: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Dwight: We did it!
column253: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Michael and Dwight: We did it! We did it!
column254: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Michael: Right here! Right here! [pounds his chest against Dwight's]
column255: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Michael and Dwight: Ouu! Ou! Ouu! Ouu!
column256: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Michael: Yeah, baby!
column257: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Dwight: In your face!
column258: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Michael: We did it!
column259: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Dwight: Oh, man.
column260: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Michael: How did we do it?
column261: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Dwight: I don't ... have no idea.
column262: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Michael: I don't understand.
column263: 03x07 - Branch Closing;Toby: Well for a minute there, I saw myself selling my house, moving to Costa Rica, learning how to surf. But, Costa Rica will still be there. When I'm 65.

column1: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: The Stamford branch is closing and everybody's just packing up their stuff. Andy Bernard made these tasteful hats.
column2: 03x08 - The Merger;Andy: [to office worker] That's the other thing you got to watch out... [to Jim] Yo! Tuna! I wanna talk to you about this new boss, Michael Scott.
column3: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: Yeah.
column4: 03x08 - The Merger;Andy: So what's he like? Likes? Dislikes? Favorite sports? Favorite movies? Favorite men's magazines?
column5: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: You know what? I think you just need to meet him.
column6: 03x08 - The Merger;Andy: Playing your cards close to the vest. I get it. Good luck over there, Tuna. Cross me and I will destroy you.
column7: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: Sounds good Andy.
column8: 03x08 - The Merger;Karen: This is going to be an adventure.
column9: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: Yes. This is going to be very interesting. All right, I'm out of here. See you later?
column10: 03x08 - The Merger;Karen: Right on. [to Andy] Hey is that Josh's computer?
column11: 03x08 - The Merger;Andy: What?
column12: 03x08 - The Merger;Pam: Hey!
column13: 03x08 - The Merger;Toby: Hey.
column14: 03x08 - The Merger;Pam: How'd the run go?
column15: 03x08 - The Merger;Toby: Ah, pretty good. I finished.
column16: 03x08 - The Merger;Pam: That's great!
column17: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: Psh, why is that great?
column18: 03x08 - The Merger;Pam: Because he accomplished something.
column19: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: What was your mile time?
column20: 03x08 - The Merger;Toby: About seven.
column21: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: [scoffs] I could beat that on a skateboard.
column22: 03x08 - The Merger;Toby: Well, that has wheels.
column23: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: Yeah, well my feet don't. And I can still crush that time.
column24: 03x08 - The Merger;Pam: Really, Dwight? How fast are you?
column25: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: Let's just put it this way. Last weekend I outran a black pepper snake.
column26: 03x08 - The Merger;Pam: Really?
column27: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: I am fast. To give you a reference point. I'm somewhere between a snake and a mongoose. And a panther.
column28: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: Man, what is taking Toby so long?
column29: 03x08 - The Merger;Pam: Oh, I'll just time him later.
column30: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: And you'll compare the times?
column31: 03x08 - The Merger;Pam: Yeah. Are you ready?
column32: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: No, my groin...
column33: 03x08 - The Merger;Pam: Set
column34: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: ...is really tight.
column35: 03x08 - The Merger;Pam: Go!
column36: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: I can't... [starts running]
column37: 03x08 - The Merger;Pam: Am I being mean to Dwight? I don't know. I did just make him run around the building and I have no intention of timing him. This isn't even a stopwatch. It's a digital thermometer. He does make my life harder, sometimes. And on purpose. Like he tried to put meters on the bathroom stalls as a way of bringing in more money for the company. [yells to Dwight] Hey, three more laps to go. Gotta pick it up if you're going to beat Toby.
column38: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: Aaaaah!
column39: 03x08 - The Merger;Pam: I should probably get back to work.
column40: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Here... Who's here?
column41: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: Nametag?
column42: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Yes, please.
column43: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: Karen Filippelli.
column44: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Karen Filip... [In Italian voice] Ka-ren Fili-pell-li.
column45: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: Probably Italian. Possibly Filipino.
column46: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Okay.
column47: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: My branch is absorbing the Stamford branch. Or, as I like to put it, my family is doubling in size. That's all I'm going to say about it because I have a gigantic performance ahead of me. And I have to get into my head and focus. [exhales]
column48: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Who's next?
column49: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: That's Andy Bernard.
column50: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Andy Bernard.
column51: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: If I were you...
column52: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Saint Bernard.
column53: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: ...I would fire Anthony Gardner...
column54: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: What?
column55: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: ...before noon...
column56: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: I'm not...
column57: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: ...to consolidate power.
column58: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: I'm not firing somebody on the first day.
column59: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: No, no, no! Not somebody. Gardner.
column60: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: The Japanese camp guards of World War II always chose one man to kill whenever a batch of new prisoners arrived. I always wondered how they chose the man who was to die. I think I would have been good at choosing the person.
column61: 03x08 - The Merger;Pam: Good morning!
column62: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Got the food? Good! Looky-looky-looky. What I want you to do... set it up in the conference room, please. Make it look nice. As if you are trying to impress a much older man who's way out of your league.
column63: 03x08 - The Merger;Pam: Okay.
column64: 03x08 - The Merger;Pam: Yes! I'm in a good mood today! I'm excited to meet all the new people and to see my old friend again, definitely. That's always a thing that makes people happy... to have an old friend back.
column65: 03x08 - The Merger;Hannah: Hello?
column66: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Ah! Ding-ding-ding-ding-ding. Our first arrival. Welcome to Scranton. This is Hannah Smoterich-Barr.
column67: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: Hannah Smoterich-Barr.
column68: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Welcome to our humble abode. Follow me to your desk. Your ball and chain is right over here.
column69: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: You know for a lot of these people this is the only family they have. So... As far as I'm concerned, [holds up WORLD'S BEST BOSS mug] this says 'World's Best Dad'.
column70: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Ah! There he is Tony... what's your last name?
column71: 03x08 - The Merger;Tony: Gardner.
column72: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Gardner! I knew that. There you go. Gift bag... for you. [laughs] Okay.
column73: 03x08 - The Merger;Tony: Thanks.
column74: 03x08 - The Merger;Kevin: Michael, I didn't get a gift bag.
column75: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Well, they're just for guests. If there are any left over, you can buy one later.
column76: 03x08 - The Merger;Hannah: My bag's mostly pencils.
column77: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Wh..and coupons... to various hot spots around Scranton. [to Tony] All right! Let me show you to your area, sir. Come on, big guy.
column78: 03x08 - The Merger;Kevin: Can I have your pencils?
column79: 03x08 - The Merger;Hannah: No.
column80: 03x08 - The Merger;Pam: Hi!
column81: 03x08 - The Merger;Karen: Hi.
column82: 03x08 - The Merger;Pam: I'm Pam.
column83: 03x08 - The Merger;Karen: Karen. I love your sweater.
column84: 03x08 - The Merger;Pam: Oh, thanks. My Mom made it for me.
column85: 03x08 - The Merger;Karen: Really? That's so cool. I've always wanted to learn...
column86: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Welcome.
column87: 03x08 - The Merger;Karen: ...to knit.
column88: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Welcome, welcome, welcome! [in robot voice] Take me to your leader. Oh wait, I am your leader.
column89: 03x08 - The Merger;Karen: Uh wait, are you a robot or a Martian?
column90: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Mmm... dah. I am actually your boss, Michael Scott. Welcome. Wow! You are very exotic looking. Was your dad a G.I. or uh?
column91: 03x08 - The Merger;Andy: I'll be the Number Two guy here in Scranton in six weeks. How? Name repetition, personality mirroring, and never breaking off a handshake. I'm always thinking one step ahead. Like a carpenter that makes stairs.
column92: 03x08 - The Merger;Andy: Hello.
column93: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Ah! You must be Andy Bernard. Aloha and welcome!
column94: 03x08 - The Merger;Andy: And you must be Michael Scott. Aloha and... hello.
column95: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: A-ha-ha-ho. Very good! Welcome to our little kingdom. Ah, we have a bag of nifty gifties for you.
column96: 03x08 - The Merger;Andy: Michael, thank you for welcoming me to your little kingdom, Mike.
column97: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Oh.
column98: 03x08 - The Merger;Andy: Nifty!
column99: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: They are nifty! They're nifty gifties.
column100: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: You know who I really like? Is this guy Andy Bernard. He has got this very likable way about him.
column101: 03x08 - The Merger;Martin: ...which is why they need a passing game.
column102: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: Right.
column103: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: [to Jim] No way. Get him out of here. We don't want any of this kind in here. Good to see you, man.
column104: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: Okay.
column105: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: [to Martin] How are you? Martin Nash, I presume? This is a little gift bag for you.
column106: 03x08 - The Merger;Martin: Oh! Thanks.
column107: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Free of charge. Follow me, I will show you where all the slaves work. [shakes head] Not... so, your desk is...
column108: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: Hi, I'm Jim. I'm new here.
column109: 03x08 - The Merger;Pam: Oh my god! It's really you!
column110: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: Yeah, I was just doing a little joke there about how we'd never met...
column111: 03x08 - The Merger;Pam: I know. I don't care.
column112: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: Awesome! Good to be back. The place looks really good.
column113: 03x08 - The Merger;Pam: It's really good to see you.
column114: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: You, too.
column115: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: Where do I stand with Pam? Um... no idea. I mean, we're friends. Always have been friends. Um... .that is where we stand.
column116: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: Well, well, well. Look what the cat dragged in from Stamford.
column117: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: Hey, Dwight.
column118: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: Fact - I am older. I am wiser. Do not mess with me.
column119: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: Okay. Sounds good.
column120: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: What are you doing?
column121: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: I don't know what you're talking about.
column122: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: I have a smudge on my forehead?
column123: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: No. Looks good.
column124: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: Why are you looking at my forehead?
column125: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: I'm not.
column126: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: Meet my eye line, Jim!
column127: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: I am.
column128: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: Stop acting like an idiot!
column129: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: Okay.
column130: 03x08 - The Merger;Ryan: Hey, buddy. Welcome back.
column131: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: Hey! How are you man? Good to see... you.
column132: 03x08 - The Merger;Ryan: I'm good! How are you? So...
column133: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: Oh, I'm sorry. Are you sitting here now?
column134: 03x08 - The Merger;Ryan: Yeah.
column135: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: Oh.
column136: 03x08 - The Merger;Ryan: Um... unless you really, really want it back.
column137: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: You know, man, it's really you're call.
column138: 03x08 - The Merger;Ryan: Cool, thank you.
column139: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: [whispers] Let me get that for you.
column140: 03x08 - The Merger;Ryan: Yuh.
column141: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: This one taken? No. Good.
column142: 03x08 - The Merger;Ryan: Yeah. Jim is a nice guy. That's why I got the desk.
column143: 03x08 - The Merger;Toby: Hey, this came with the Stamford book. [Sets down box that says: Personnel Files Stamford CT Office Confidential] Can you take care of it?
column144: 03x08 - The Merger;Kevin: Oh, yes I can.
column145: 03x08 - The Merger;Kevin: In general, they do not give me much responsibility. But they do let me shred the company documents. And that is really all I need.
column146: 03x08 - The Merger;Andy: Michael Scott. Thank you. I appreciate it, Mike.
column147: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Right.
column148: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: Hello. I don't believe we've been introduced. Dwight Schrute. Assistant Regional Manager.
column149: 03x08 - The Merger;Andy: Andy Bernard. Regional Director in Charge of Sales.
column150: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: So you'll be reporting to me, then.
column151: 03x08 - The Merger;Andy: Umm, on the contrary.
column152: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: My title has 'Manager' in it.
column153: 03x08 - The Merger;Andy: And I'm a director.
column154: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: Oh.
column155: 03x08 - The Merger;Andy: Which on a film set is the highest title there is. Do you know anything about film?
column156: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: I know everything about film. I've seen over 240 of them.
column157: 03x08 - The Merger;Andy: Congratulations.
column158: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: Hey, Toby!
column159: 03x08 - The Merger;Toby: Hey, Jim!
column160: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: How are you, man?
column161: 03x08 - The Merger;Toby: Oh, really good.
column162: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: I just wanted to say hi.
column163: 03x08 - The Merger;Toby: How are you? Hey. Welcome back. [puts out fist to bump]
column164: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: Oh. Is that like your new thing?
column165: 03x08 - The Merger;Toby: No, I'm sorry, it's...
column166: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: No. It's cool.
column167: 03x08 - The Merger;Toby: No, it's nothing. We'll just... [shakes hand]
column168: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: All right. Good to be back.
column169: 03x08 - The Merger;Toby: So... okay.
column170: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: All right.
column171: 03x08 - The Merger;Toby: All right... sorry... sorry about that.
column172: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: No problem.
column173: 03x08 - The Merger;Toby: It was just...
column174: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: [off camera] ...what?
column175: 03x08 - The Merger;Toby: Nothing.
column176: 03x08 - The Merger;Kevin: This thing is so awesome. It will shred anything. Ooh! It will shred a CD. It will shred... a credit card. It will shred... oh! [whispers] Shoot.
column177: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: [talking to himself] I present the orientation video.
column178: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: We need to talk!
column179: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Not now.
column180: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: Which is higher? Assistant Regional Manager or Regional Director in Charge of Sales?
column181: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: I told you the titles are irrelevant. They just relate to pay scale.
column182: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: Okay. So who gets paid more? Me or Andy?
column183: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: It is not a matter of more or less. Your pay is just different. Okay? All right! Show time, part one.
column184: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: Ok. Who reports to who?
column185: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: I don't care! Dwight! You all report to me! That's all that matters! The rest of it just work out amongst yourselves, ok?
column186: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: And then if I want...
column187: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Work it out amongst your selves!
column188: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: I...
column189: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Please! I have a company to run. Well, you let me run the company?
column190: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: I...
column191: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Will you?
column192: 03x08 - The Merger;Dwight: One...
column193: 03x08 - The Merger;Michael: Please?
column194: 03x08 - The Merger;Kelly: Jim!
column195: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: Kelly!
column196: 03x08 - The Merger;Kelly: Oh! Oh my god! I have so much to tell you!
column197: 03x08 - The Merger;Jim: Really?

column264: 03x23 - Beach Games;Angela: Or Mrs. "Outside Hire."
column265: 03x23 - Beach Games;Michael: Yeah. Ummm, hmm... True. column267: 03x23 - Beach Games;Michael: God! He's a comedian.
column268: 03x23 - Beach Games;Kelly: Oh, like Amanda Bynes.
column269: 03x23 - Beach Games;Michael: Who's Amanda Bynes?
column270: 03x23 - Beach Games;Kelly: She's from "What a Girl Wants."
column271: 03x23 - Beach Games;Michael: Oh, I love that movie. Yes, Kelly is right, the person to replace me has to have a great sense of humor and they have to possess the leadership qualities of a Bynes or a Hope. So without further ado, Jim and Dwight show us what you got.

column273: 03x23 - Beach Games;Michael: You are being too modest.
column274: 03x23 - Beach Games;Jim: Michael, on Thursday I'm going to drive down and interview with David for the open position in New York.
column275: 03x23 - Beach Games;Michael: Hhhh... okay. That is not funny. I am deducting sixty points from Voldemort for false pretenses. Okay, Dwight your turn. Wow us.
column276: 03x23 - Beach Games;Dwight: The Aristocrats. A man and his wife and his children go into the offices of a talent agency. And the talent agent says, "Describe your act." column277: 03x23 - Beach Games;Pam: [breathes deeply and runs across coals] Oooh, uh hah, ooh! Wha-hoo! Ahhhh...
column278: 03x23 - Beach Games;Dwight: [finishes story] I mean truly repulsive acts.
column279: 03x23 - Beach Games;Michael: That is a very, very funny story.
column280: 03x23 - Beach Games;Pam: [runs over after walking over fire coals] Hey! I want to say something. I've been trying to be more honest lately and I just need to say a few things. And that's... fine. It's... whatever. That's not what... I'm not... Okay, my feet really hurt. The thing that I'm just trying to say to you, Jim... and to everyone else in this circle I guess, is that I miss having fun with you. Just you, not everyone in the circle. column147: 05x12 - The Duel;
column148: 05x12 - The Duel;

column156: 05x12 - The Duel;Angela: A little bit.
column157: 05x12 - The Duel;Andy: How long has it been going on?
column158: 05x12 - The Duel;Angela: I don't know. I mean, we were together, and then he killed sprinkles, and then we stopped, and... I don't know exactly when we started up again.

column160: 05x12 - The Duel;Angela: Michael.

column163: 05x12 - The Duel;Andy: Oh God. Come on!
column164: 05x12 - The Duel;David: So listen, Michael, your branch has been doing great lately, and your sales staff is reporting very strong numbers. Out-performing last year, in fact. Um, and I don't know exactly how to put this, but... what are you doing right?

column166: 05x12 - The Duel;David: Utica, Albany, all the other branches are struggling, but your branch is reporting strong numbers. [Michael smiles] Look, you're not our most traditional guy, but clearly, something you are doing... is right. And I just, I need to get a sense of what that is.

column168: 05x12 - The Duel;Michael: Sometimes I'll start a sentence, and I don't even know where it's going. I just hope I find it along the way. Like an improv conversation. An improversation.
column169: 05x12 - The Duel;Michael: This is going to sound sort of high-maintenance, but could we have it, like, three degrees cooler in here? I always think better when it's cooler.
column170: 05x12 - The Duel;David: Here's the thing. Michael is doing something right. And in this economic climate, no method of success can be ignored. It's not really time for executives to start getting judgmental now. It's Hail Mary time.

column208: 05x12 - The Duel;Jim: Nope.

column210: 05x12 - The Duel;Andy: Fine!
column211: 05x12 - The Duel;Dwight: Fine!

column220: 05x12 - The Duel;Dwight: Outside of work.
column221: 05x12 - The Duel;Andy: None of your business.

column225: 05x12 - The Duel;Andy: Then I'll get something too.

column230: 05x12 - The Duel;Meredith: I call loser!

column234: 05x12 - The Duel;Dwight: Mm.

column241: 05x12 - The Duel;David: It's hard to try and evaluate yourself, Michael, but I appreciate you trying. [gets up] And thanks for coming in.

column43: 06x03 - The Promotion;Oscar: Look, it doesn't take a genius to know that any organization thrives when it has two leaders. Go ahead, name a country that doesn't have two presidents. A boat that sets sail without two captains. Where would Catholicism be without the popes?
column44: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: I have noticed that we--
column45: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Welcome.
column46: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Thank you. I've noticed we've been having a lot of conference room meetings.
column47: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Mm-hmm.
column48: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: And I'm wondEring if perhaps those are a bit, um--
column49: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Disruptive.
column50: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Yes.
column51: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: No, I don't think they are. I think the meetings are very important.
column52: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Okay, maybe we should talk specifics.
column53: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Let's do.
column54: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Okay. Yesterday, we had a meeting about planets.
column55: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: N-- well, to be fair, Jim... James... Jimothy... To be fair, Jimothy, the-- ah, that sounds weird. Are you okay with being called Jim?
column56: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: I am.
column57: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Alright. Jim, to be fair, the conversation wasn't about planets...
column58: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Right.
column59: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: At first, we were talking about introducing a line of toilet paper. And what part of the human body does one use toilet paper upon? So you draw a line from there to the other planets, and I think by the end, we all learned a little bit about how small we are.
column60: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Yes, I agree.
column61: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Because it's a big universe, and we're all just little, tiny specks of dust.
column62: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: I just think that maybe they're eating large amounts of the day.
column63: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: You know what eats a large amount of the day are naps. You go to sleep, it's light out, you wake up, it's dark. That's the whole day. Where did that day go? I have no idea.
column64: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: You mean on a weekend?
column65: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Yes.
column66: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: How about this? I think our goal should be we don't have meetings unless they're absolutely essential.
column67: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Alright. No more meetings this week.
column68: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Really? You just agreed to that?
column69: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: I can be very suprising.
column70: 06x03 - The Promotion;Phyllis: What's going on?
column71: 06x03 - The Promotion;Pam: I need to fit into my wedding dress. However, I'm also pregnant.
column72: 06x03 - The Promotion;Ryan: You know, it's a myth that women have to gain more than nine pounds in a pregnancy. Look at these actresses. Some of them lose weight.
column73: 06x03 - The Promotion;Phyllis: Hey, did you guys register for wedding gifts?
column74: 06x03 - The Promotion;Pam: We did, but mostly because people expect us to. We're also accepting other gifts not on the registry... However much.
column75: 06x03 - The Promotion;Pam: It's awkward asking people for money, but we could really use it. Why doesn't Crate & Barrel let you register for a toaster full of cash?
column76: 06x03 - The Promotion;Phyllis: Perfect. I hate registries.
column77: 06x03 - The Promotion;Pam: Oh, good.
column78: 06x03 - The Promotion;Phyllis: My cousin makes the most amazing romantic birdhouse mailboxes. I know I shouldn't tell you, but you'll still be suprised when you see it. You're not registered for a birdhouse, are you?
column79: 06x03 - The Promotion;Pam: No, we're not.
column80: 06x03 - The Promotion;Phyllis: Good. Good.
column81: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Mm-hmm?
column82: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: [walks in, see's Oscar, Stanley, Creed and Kelly sitting in Michaels office] Okay, I thought I saw people missing.
column83: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Yeah, just focus-grouping a product expansion idea to these folks. Got one of each.
column84: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Really? Hey, Stanley, what was the last thing Michael said before I came through the door?
column85: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Stanley, you don't need to answer that.
column86: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Stanley?
column87: 06x03 - The Promotion;Stanley: "If you don't smell this, you're fired."
column88: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Okay, Michael, I thought we agreed to not take up people's time with meetings like these.
column89: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: What do you mean by "these people"?
column90: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Michael, this is a conference room meeting.
column91: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Oh, hey, everybody, I think that Jim has gone insane, because he thinks that my office is a conference room.
column92: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: That's not what I meant.
column93: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Listen, Jim, no offense, but when push comes to shove, what I want is more important that what you want.
column94: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: I disagree.
column95: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: What do you guys think? [all start talking at the same time]
column96: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Great. Guys, can I just have a moment alone with Michael?
column97: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: No, no, no, you don't need to go anywhere. Anything that Jim has to say to me, he can say in front of these types of people.
column98: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: That is not what I said, and, also, I am co-manager, meaning you are not the only manager anymore. I am also I co-manager.
column99: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: That is not what Wallace told us.
column100: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: That's exactly what Wallace told us.
column101: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: That is not the way I heard it.
column102: 06x03 - The Promotion;Kelly: I love rivalries-- Michael or Jim, Paris or Nicole, Heidi or L.C. It's so much fun. But I guess if I'm really thinking about it and answEring your question honestly, I'd have to go with L.C. Heidi's a bad friend, and her skin is terrible.
column103: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: It is one thing, me giving you the co-manager title. It is another thing, you bossing me around.
column104: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: I'm not bossing you around. I'm trying to do my job, which is sharing your job, so maybe we should just call David Wallace.
column105: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: No, no, no. No, we will not call David Wallace. [Michael pulls out his cell phone] I will call David Wallace.
column106: 06x03 - The Promotion;Erin: David Wallace is on line two for you guys.
column107: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Or David Wallace will call us on line two. Why don't we just--
column108: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Hey, David. You got Jim here.
column109: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Hey David, this is Michael, senior co-manager.
column110: 06x03 - The Promotion;David Wallace: Hey guys, um, I'm calling, because, unfortunately, we will not be able to give out cost of living raises this year, and I know people expect it. However, there just is only a small amount of money for each branch, so we're leaving it up to the managers to decide how to distribute it.
column111: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Got it, Dave. Sounds like your classice big-picture decision.
column112: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Which will clearly affect the day-to-day well-being of our employees.
column113: 06x03 - The Promotion;David Wallace: It's probably a little of both.
column114: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Which is it more of?
column115: 06x03 - The Promotion;David Wallace: Excuse me?
column116: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: David, I know that I'm very new at this, but I have a very good perspective on how things work.
column117: 06x03 - The Promotion;David Wallace: Wait, I'm sorry. Michael, are you-- are you texting me?
column118: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: I thought maybe we could talk after this is over.
column119: 06x03 - The Promotion;David Wallace: Look, I need you both to take care of this. This is not going to be a problem, is it?
column120: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Nope, not at all.
column121: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: No, it will not be. I am on top of it.
column122: 06x03 - The Promotion;David Wallace: Very good.
column123: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Alright, thanks alot, David.
column124: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Talk to you later-- [Jim hangs up] Okay, you didn't let me say good-bye. [sighs, and claps hands once] Alright, I am looking forward to this.
column125: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: You don't have to lie.
column126: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: I hate the fact that we have to do this together. I think we work better separately. When I am irritated and I look at you, I don't see you anymore.
column127: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Right.
column128: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: All I can see is how big and gross the pores on your nose are.
column129: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Alright. Let's get started.
column130: 06x03 - The Promotion;Creed: Hey, why haven't we ever, um...
column131: 06x03 - The Promotion;Meredith: We have.
column132: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: You know, there's no easy way to do this. I say we add 1.5% to their paychecks and don't say anything about it.
column133: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Do you mean, like break-in in the middle of the night and change the numbers on payroll?
column134: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: No, we can do it during the day. It doesn't have to be that dramatic, Jim.
column135: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Okay. You know what would help is a pros and cons list for our options.
column136: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Jim, don't take this the wrong way. Are you gonna take this the wrong way?
column137: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: It's hard to tell so far.
column138: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: You use your brain too much.
column139: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: I'm sorry, are you advocating that I use it less?
column140: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Sometimes the smartest people don't think at all.
column141: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: You just came up with that.
column142: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: As I was saying it.
column143: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Yeah. Okay, so for the 1.5% increase, pro-- everyone gets a little bit.
column144: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: [in nerdy voice] Con-- you look like a nerd.
column145: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Con-- no one gets as much as they did last year.
column146: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Pro-- you get to share your pros and cons list with the other nerds.
column147: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Pro-- no favoritism.
column148: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Con-- you unzip your pants, and you find that there's a calculator down there.
column149: 06x03 - The Promotion;
column150: 06x03 - The Promotion;
column151: 06x03 - The Promotion;
column152: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: I've been studying Michael for years, and I've condensed what I've learned into this chart-- [pulls out a pie chart] How Michael spends his time. As you can see, we have procrastinating and distracting others, and this tiny sliver here is critical thinking. I made it bigger, so that you could see it.
column153: 06x03 - The Promotion;Kevin: Hey, Pam, I heard that you were registered, but I didn't hear where.
column154: 06x03 - The Promotion;Pam: I don't think we registered anywhere. We just want cash.
column155: 06x03 - The Promotion;Kevin: Like money? Like you-- you want my money?
column156: 06x03 - The Promotion;Pam: Mm-hmm.
column157: 06x03 - The Promotion;Kevin: Will you take a check?
column158: 06x03 - The Promotion;Pam: Yeah.
column159: 06x03 - The Promotion;Kevin: Cool. In the memo line, I'm gonna write, "To love's eternal glory."
column160: 06x03 - The Promotion;Pam: Okay.
column161: 06x03 - The Promotion;Kevin: Wait til' Monday.
column162: 06x03 - The Promotion;Pam: Is this what I've become? Materialistic? Shallow? I feel horrible. [looks down at the check] oh look! "Mrs. Pam Halpert!" That's the first time I've seen it in writing!
column163: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: You know, the more I think about it, the more I think we should give it to the salesmen.
column164: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: That will not go over well.
column165: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: I know. I just think it seems smart to keep the salesmen happy right now. 'Course I know that this might come off as biased, so you know what? Let us...
column166: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Oh, my God! Are you gonna make another pro and con list? I'm gonna kill myself.
column167: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: I'm not gonna let you stop me from thinking.
column168: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: No! I could not do that, Jim. I can see it in your crusty little eyes that you are going to make everything perfect. If I can just think this through, if I could just think it exactly right, I can make this perfect, and then I can go down every avenue, and every avenue off of that avenue, and then another avenue.
column169: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Michael.
column170: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: And then another--
column171: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Look, you have a lot of strengths.
column172: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Oh, I do?! Tell me what they are.
column173: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: I think that you are able to take constructive criticism very well.
column174: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Ha! That-- I am not known for that!
column175: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: But there is a reason why I'm here!
column176: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Yes! You went over my head to Wallace!
column177: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: No, it's because you also have a lot of weaknesses, Michael!
column178: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Okay. Well, why don't you tell me what those are, Jim? Why don't you enliven me?
column179: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: I don't think you're good at making tough decisions!
column180: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Ah.
column181: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: At thinking out the options, and then stating that decision very clearly, especially when it's an unpopular decision.
column182: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Okay, here's a tough decision for you. You suck! You suck! Is that clear enough for you?!
column183: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: But maybe I'm here for a reason, because I might have some good ideas, too. I've been sitting out there, and I've been learning a lot, and maybe I can just bring something different to the table.
column184: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Okay, Skippy, here we go. Why don't you run yourself out there and tell them? [laughs] You call it.
column185: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: [leave the conference room to address everyone]
column186: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: [to the camera] This had better be terrible.
column187: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Could I have everyone's attention, please? I have some tough news, so I'm just gonna give it to you straight. Truth is, we only have so much money for raises this year, so the simple fact is some people will get raises, and some people won't. Now, what we've decided is, we are gonna give those raises to the sales staff.
column188: 06x03 - The Promotion;Meredith: Wait. Seriously?!
column189: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Look, you guys are smart, so I'm just leveling with you. I'm just trying to treat you like adults.
column190: 06x03 - The Promotion;Oscar: Thank you, Jim, for thinking that we're smart people.
column191: 06x03 - The Promotion;Angela: But, I do not understand. If we're such smart adults, then why don't we get raises?
column192: 06x03 - The Promotion;Oscar: Excellent question, genius. It's because Jim wants to give the raises to his friends and the people he sleeps with.
column193: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Ooh, easy. That's not it at all.
column194: 06x03 - The Promotion;Oscar: Well?
column195: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Really what it is, is about the money the sales staff brings into the office.
column196: 06x03 - The Promotion;Kelly: [walks in from shopping, with bags in her hands] What's going on?
column197: 06x03 - The Promotion;Kevin: Jim is only giving raises to the salesmen.
column198: 06x03 - The Promotion;Kelly: What the hell?! Why are you being such a jerk?!
column199: 06x03 - The Promotion;Oscar: Hold on, Kelly. Would it help you to know that Jim thinks you're smart?
column200: 06x03 - The Promotion;Kelly: No! [put's down her bags] How is that gonna repair Ryan's car?!
column201: 06x03 - The Promotion;Dwight: This is ridiculous! How could he do this to us?!
column202: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Okay, Dwight, you know what? You'd be getting the raise so--
column203: 06x03 - The Promotion;Dwight: What about all these people, huh?! How is it fair to them?!
column204: 06x03 - The Promotion;Oscar: Exactly!
column205: 06x03 - The Promotion;Kevin: Totally!
column206: 06x03 - The Promotion;Oscar: We work just as hard as the sales people. We deserve raises.
column207: 06x03 - The Promotion;Creed: Yes.
column208: 06x03 - The Promotion;Angela: Yes. They don't get 'em, if we don't get 'em!
column209: 06x03 - The Promotion;Meredith: My kid needs shoes! You want to tell him he doesn't get shoes?!
column210: 06x03 - The Promotion;Kevin: Yeah.
column211: 06x03 - The Promotion;Dwight: Her kid needs shoes, Jim!
column212: 06x03 - The Promotion;Meredith: What the hell?! [everyone complaining at Jim]
column213: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Wow! I'm just gonna rewind and back off a bit, so... [imitates a tape rewinding and chuckles, Michael comes over by Jim laughing]
column214: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: That was good! That was good! Okay, all right. Well, we all know it's hard to be a boss, right? You know what? Look around you. These are your best friends. These are the people who will open their hearts to you. They all have heart-ons for you [someone growns in disgust], and that is a gift. So in terms of gifts, we should be giving each other gifts. Angela, yes, lend Oscar a cup of sugar. This--
column215: 06x03 - The Promotion;Angela: What are you talking about Michael?
column216: 06x03 - The Promotion;Stanley: We just need to hear your plan for our raise.
column217: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: My plan-- a man-- panama.
column218: 06x03 - The Promotion;Andy: That's not how that goes.
column219: 06x03 - The Promotion;Meredith: You're not saying anything. At least Jim was being direct...
column220: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Thank you, Meredith.
column221: 06x03 - The Promotion;Meredith: ...when he was telling us his dumbass plan.
column222: 06x03 - The Promotion;Oscar: We would just like to know what's happening. Are we getting a raise, yes or no?
column223: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Alright! Let me get this clear! Does everybody want a raise? [all say yes] Alright, everyone wants a raise, so what we're going to do is go into here, and we will not come out until we do.
column224: 06x03 - The Promotion;Oscar: Again, that gives us no information.
column225: 06x03 - The Promotion;Phyllis: This isn't a game, you know? It's our livelihood!
column226: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: What about a raise based on merit?
column227: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Rank each person individually?
column228: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Mm-hmm. Piece of cake. Ryan, obviously the best.
column229: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: [sarcastically] Well, obviously. Too bad he's a temp and doesn't count, so let's get started. [starts to write on a piece of paper]
column230: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Are you making a--
column231: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Nope. I'm numbering the paper.
column232: 06x03 - The Promotion;Oscar: [everyone talking to the camera] Just--
column233: 06x03 - The Promotion;Kevin: Yeah, I don't understand how they can even consider giving money to some people and not the rest of us.
column234: 06x03 - The Promotion;Angela: It's not like we're not gonna see the checks. We're in accounting!
column235: 06x03 - The Promotion;Meredith: I am so pissed at this company!
column236: 06x03 - The Promotion;Dwight: [out the side of his mouth] And Jim!
column237: 06x03 - The Promotion;Meredith: Yeah. Who said that?
column238: 06x03 - The Promotion;Dwight: I think it was Creed.
column239: 06x03 - The Promotion;Creed: Yep.
column240: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: [to camera] It's going really well, actually.
column241: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: [to camera, holds up a bean] Each Boston Baked Bean represents half a percent raise. We each got 24 beans, so the idea is, you place the bean on the picture [walking around the table] of who you think deserv-- who's that? [picture that Michael drew of toby, looks like a monster]
column242: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Toby.
column243: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: He's not a part of this. You know that.
column244: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Just wanted to draw a picture of him.
column245: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Okay, your move.
column246: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Alright! Who to pick? [walking around the table] Who to pick?
column247: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Here we go.
column248: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: I... will skip a turn.
column249: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Okay, you're gonna still have to play that bean. You know that.
column250: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: I need more time.
column251: 06x03 - The Promotion;Erin: Wallace sent an e-mail about a meeting next week. He wants you both to respond. [Michael and Jim leave, Dwight sneaks in]
column252: 06x03 - The Promotion;Dwight: People are starting to notice how terrible Jim is. It's great. Eventually, they'll rise up and revolt. My only hope is that they do it sooner rather than later. If the people here were our founding fathers, the Revolutionary War would have been delayed ten years, because Stanley Washington was napping, and Phyllis Hancock was still signing the declaration, and Kevin Jefferson was distracted by a butterfly.
column253: 06x03 - The Promotion;Dwight: Come on in. [everyone looking around at all the pictures and beans on the table] That's right. Come in, feast your eyes. They determine our worth by putting beans upon our faces.
column254: 06x03 - The Promotion;Oscar: What the hell?!
column255: 06x03 - The Promotion;Dwight: Things were not this bad when just Michael was manager.
column256: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Hey, what are you guys doing in here?
column257: 06x03 - The Promotion;Kevin: What does a bean mean?
column258: 06x03 - The Promotion;Pam: Why aren't there any beans on this very old, frizzy-haired picture of me?
column259: 06x03 - The Promotion;Kevin: Michael, what does a bean mean?
column260: 06x03 - The Promotion;Pam: Jim?
column261: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: I was just trying to be unbiased.
column262: 06x03 - The Promotion;Kevin: What does a bean mean?!
column263: 06x03 - The Promotion;Oscar: Someone please explain it to Kevin.
column264: 06x03 - The Promotion;Meredith: Why can't you? My time is just as valuable as yours.
column265: 06x03 - The Promotion;Phyllis: Not according to the beans.
column266: 06x03 - The Promotion;Angela: This is how you make this important decision?
column267: 06x03 - The Promotion;Andy: There's no way that Stanley gets more beans than me. [starts to take Stanley's beans, Stanley swats Andy's hand with his crossword puzzle] That is ridiculous. This is how it works. [everyone continues to argue]
column268: 06x03 - The Promotion;Phyllis: It's not so much that I might not get a raise. It's just demeaning!
column269: 06x03 - The Promotion;Andy: Thank you! That is exactly-- by the way, I would also like a raise.
column270: 06x03 - The Promotion;Phyllis: Yeah, I would, too.
column271: 06x03 - The Promotion;Dwight: Are we idiots? [gets up, starts walking around] What right does Jim have to claim authority, hmm? Is he as good a salesman as I? Is he as matronly as Phyllis? There are moments where we can affect change. For a few seconds every decade, we exist, and these are those seconds! Let us storm his castle! Come on! Tick-- let's get him. Tock-- let's get Jim! Tick-- and drag Jim out of his office! Tock-- take his keys away from him! Tick-- that's a clock! The time is getting very close! It's now or never! What say you?!
column272: 06x03 - The Promotion;Phyllis: I say no.
column273: 06x03 - The Promotion;Dwight: No, I mean, what do you say to my plan? [all groan] Okay.
column274: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: [leaving his office, hurrying to Jim's office]
column275: 06x03 - The Promotion;Kevin: What does a bean mean?
column276: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: [in Jim's office] How you doing?
column277: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Uh, on a scale of one to ten, I'd say I'm about a four.
column278: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Oh, what are you usually?
column279: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Six. You?
column280: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Usually a ten, but I'm feeling like a zero.
column281: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: I mean, a performance-based raise sounded like a good idea, right?
column282: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: I know, I know.
column283: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: We tried to find the fairest way to do it.
column284: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Yes, we did.
column285: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: I just-- what?
column286: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Um, nothing. I just... I used to have to do this part alone, and it was the worst. I have something I would like to give you. [leaves office]
column287: 06x03 - The Promotion;Phyllis: Michael!
column288: 06x03 - The Promotion;Kevin: Michael!
column289: 06x03 - The Promotion;Phyllis: Come on! This isn't fair!
column290: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: [to camera] Michael's my only friend left in the office. Except Pam... I think. Is she still upset?
column291: 06x03 - The Promotion;Phyllis: [at Michael return to Jim's office] Michael, you cannot just keep avoiding us like this!
column292: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: [Michael give Jim a "World's Best Boss" mug] Thank you.
column293: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: You're welcome.
column294: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: What's in here?
column295: 06x03 - The Promotion;Michael: Gin. [toast, sip]
column296: 06x03 - The Promotion;Jim: Ooh!
