column173: 06x06 - Mafia;Rep: I'm going to go ahead and put a hold on your card.
column174: 06x06 - Mafia;Kevin: No. That... I, I think that we should let the criminal use the card a little longer.
column175: 06x06 - Mafia;Rep: Very funny sir. We'll get a new card out to you right away.
column176: 06x06 - Mafia;Kevin: No-
column177: 06x06 - Mafia;Rep: Have a nice day, and thank you!
column178: 06x06 - Mafia;Kevin: Shoot.
column179: 06x06 - Mafia;Grotti: If you want to supplement your coverage, we can do that. If you want to replace your current coverage, all the better. Ah, you seem like a nice guy.
column180: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: Oh he's not that nice.
column181: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: That's not true.
column182: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: Hmm. Very true.
column183: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Okay shut up.
column184: 06x06 - Mafia;Waitress: Have you decided?
column185: 06x06 - Mafia;Grotti: Yeah, I'll have the linguini, red sauce on the side. If the sauce does not come on the side, I will send it back. I want garlic bread, toasted, not burnt. If it comes burnt, I will send it back.
column186: 06x06 - Mafia;Waitress: Okay then. And for you sir?
column187: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: I will have the gabba-gool.
column188: 06x06 - Mafia;Waitress: The... what?
column189: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: The gabba-gool.
column190: 06x06 - Mafia;Waitress: I don't really know what that is.
column191: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: [with Soprano's inflection] You know, gabba-gool.
column192: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: I don't, I don't have to have that.
column193: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: What he's trying to say is, Gabba. Gool.
column194: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Guys, guys-
column195: 06x06 - Mafia;Waitress: I don't really think that we have that.
column196: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: That's okay.
column197: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: Bring him the gabba-gool!
column198: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Shh. I will have the spaghetti, with a side salad.
column199: 06x06 - Mafia;Waitress: Okay.
column200: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: If the salad is on top, I send it back.
column201: 06x06 - Mafia;Oscar: Why would you cancel Jim's credit cards?
column202: 06x06 - Mafia;Kevin: I usually can think quick on my feet, but they were so fast on the phone.
column203: 06x06 - Mafia;Oscar: This constitutes identity fraud.
column204: 06x06 - Mafia;Kevin: Oh God. I wouldn't last in jail Oscar. I'm not like you.
column205: 06x06 - Mafia;Oscar: What's that supposed to mean?
column206: 06x06 - Mafia;Kevin: Oh you don't know about jail? Oh you would love jail.
column207: 06x06 - Mafia;Oscar: Why would I love jail?
column208: 06x06 - Mafia;Kevin: Because... You would love it.
column209: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: I don't think our company actually needs any more insurance. So I am out.
column210: 06x06 - Mafia;Grotti: Look closely Michael. I feel there's a plan here for you.
column211: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: Maybe we have a plan for you?
column212: 06x06 - Mafia;Grotti: How about you? Maybe you can use supplemental coverage of some kind. Anybody can get hurt! You always think, it can't happen to you, and [drops hand loudly on table] Think about it.
column213: 06x06 - Mafia;Woman: [approaches with child] Excuse me. Sorry to bother you. Are you a mechanic?
column214: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: Yeeeeah.
column215: 06x06 - Mafia;Woman: My battery is dead, I've got my kid, can you please help?
column216: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: Yes I can.
column217: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: No, no no, no. Come on. I'm sorry, we're having our salad.
column218: 06x06 - Mafia;Grotti: Come on! Lady in distress? Go! Go!
column219: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: Okay!
column220: 06x06 - Mafia;Woman: Thank you so much, I really appreciate it.
column221: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Hey, do you need any help?
column222: 06x06 - Mafia;Grotti: I'm sure he can handle a simple jump-start. Now come on, sit down.
column223: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: He's a good mechanic.
column224: 06x06 - Mafia;Grotti: Where were we?
column225: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: I don't...
column226: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: He was trying to force you to decide on a policy.
column227: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Okay, okay okay.
column228: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: So we're choosing...
column229: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Yep, all right.
column230: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: Check out Dental?
column231: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Put it down.
column232: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: Black goes on the red. With the... If we... Positive... Mo- it being a motor drive, it's probably down.
column233: 06x06 - Mafia;Kid: He seems bad at this.
column234: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: You want to do this junior? I didn't think so. Sorry. It's kind of a long day at the... mechanic store. [Andy places connections wrong, smoke and explosion set off] Aaaah! You got a leaky spark tube.
column235: 06x06 - Mafia;Woman: What?!?
column236: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: So your car's totaled. Uh, you're just gonna want to get a refund on that. Or my guy could do it. He's great. But uh, I can't do that for you. I work exclusively on motorcycles. [Andy walks away, woman is exasperated]
column237: 06x06 - Mafia;Grotti: Now if you could just sign this letter of intent, I'll bring this back to my boss, and we can get this in motion. [Andy clears throat loudly] You okay, Pat?
column238: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: Yeah. Just thinking about how, uh, I had this car, this Italian car, and I was driving it, and it kept telling me how much it needed oil, but I wouldn't give it any oil. And then, one day it exploded and it killed everyone and that's what I'm afraid of.
column239: 06x06 - Mafia;Grotti: Aren't you a mechanic? Why wouldn't you put oil in the car?
column240: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: It was before, my tech- my technical training.
column241: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: Don't do it!
column242: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: Do it.
column243: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: Don't.
column244: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: Just do it.
column245: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Okay.
column246: 06x06 - Mafia;Grotti: Look Mike, I don't know what your friends are telling you, but you have to decide for yourself. Are these guys gonna take care of your things if you die tomorrow?
column247: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: Yes.
column248: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Okay.
column249: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: I don't understand, why would you buy a policy?
column250: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: It's just the cost of a cup of coffee an hour.
column251: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: You were man enough to back down Michael, I'm proud of you.
column252: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: I had to make a snap decision Dwight.
column253: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: It wasn't a snap decision, you were sitting there for an hour.
column254: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: It was a lot of snap decisions.
column255: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: Do you know what "snap decision" means?
column256: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Yes!
column257: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: It means like this. [snaps fingers]
column258: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Just get in the car.
column259: 06x06 - Mafia;Jim: Hello?
column260: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Jim?
column261: 06x06 - Mafia;Jim: Michael?
column262: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Oh thank God.
column263: 06x06 - Mafia;Jim: How did you get this number? Michael, we're on a catamaran.
column264: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: It wasn't easy. I had to tell the hotel it was a medical emergency. I chose massive coronary, cause you told me that your Dad had a bad heart. Listen man, I, I got a problem, I think I'm in trouble with the mob. Or a major insurance carrier.
column265: 06x06 - Mafia;Jim: That sounds bad.
column266: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Yeah, I know and you usually can get out of stuff like this, so I'm turning to you my friend.
column267: 06x06 - Mafia;Jim: I'm gonna help you through it all right?
column268: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Okay!
column269: 06x06 - Mafia;Jim: All you're gonna need to [faking a bad connection] and- it- and then go to--
column270: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Jim? Are you?
column271: 06x06 - Mafia;Jim: And then you'll be saved.
column272: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: What? Wait, I didn't hear a thing you just said.
column273: 06x06 - Mafia;Jim: Just [drops] and then you'll be saved.
column274: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: No! God! I missed, I missed the important part again!
column275: 06x06 - Mafia;Jim: A- ah--
column276: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: No! Oh my God!
column277: 06x06 - Mafia;Jim: And you'll be saved.
column278: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: No, Jim please, repeat what you're saying! I can't understand you!
column279: 06x06 - Mafia;Jim: I [drops out] at the Bermuda Triangle. An- M- please don't call again.
column280: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Jim?!? [dial tone] Oh my God.
column281: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Hey uh, question for you. I recently purchased some insurance that I can't afford given my present salary. Is there anything accounting-wise I can do to sort of make it all go away?
column282: 06x06 - Mafia;Oscar: Accounting-wise, no. But phone-wise, just call up and cancel it.
column283: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Oh no. Um. What about this Cash For Clunkers thing?
column284: 06x06 - Mafia;Oscar: Just- no. No.
column285: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: All right. Well, it was a thought. Thanks.
column286: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: We have let Michael down, and it's 85 percent your fault.
column287: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: He's alive. So you're welcome.
column288: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: Not on the inside he's not. Look at his life! Broke! Living in fear! No friends, dead end job.
column289: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: Yeah, some of that existed before.
column290: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: Not the living in fear, that's new.
column291: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: You're right, that is new.
column292: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: Yes. He's got to stand up to this mafia guy.
column293: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: Well I don't see that happening.
column294: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: Me neither. Not the way things are now. But what if Michael felt no fear toward the mafia guy?
column295: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: Are you saying-
column296: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: Yeah...
column297: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: That we surgically remove the fear center from Michael's brain?
column298: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: What is wrong with you? I am talking about convincing Michael that the guy's not mafia!
column299: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: That seems a little far-fetched.
column300: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: Well more far-fetched than a mobster walking into a paper company for a low-level shakedown? And that happened.
column301: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: Michael. Incredible news. Grotti is clean.
column302: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: No. He's not. He's just good. Nothing sticks to him. You still don't understand how this works.
column303: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: No, Michael. What we're trying to say is, we made a mistake assuming he was mafia. I have a buddy who's a Fed, and we did a background check on the guy. His background is perfectly clean.
column304: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: It's true, he's clean. I have a couple of friends still on the force. Checked with them. Ran his Fed friend up the flagpole to make sure he wasn't on the take. Turns out he's a totally lovely guy. Sweetest guy on the force really.
column305: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: Class act. Boy scout.
column306: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: But Grotti acts like he's mafia though.
column307: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: He's trying to intimidate you to close sales. He's just a pushy salesman.
column308: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: And he made us all look like chumps!
column309: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: [grunts]
column310: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: If there is one thing I hate more than the mafia it is a liar. I wish the mafia would go out and kill all the liars. Bury them in my yard. And I wouldn't tell the cops a thing. Not that I would be lying per se. But I would just get really quiet, all of a sudden.
column311: 06x06 - Mafia;Grotti: This is Grotti.
column312: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: This is Scott.
column313: 06x06 - Mafia;Grotti: Oh! Great. Michael, I'm finishing up your paperwork right now.
column314: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Oh really? Is that supposed to scare me?
column315: 06x06 - Mafia;Grotti: I, I thought you'd be pleased.
column316: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Well you thought wrong. Because I am not pleased. I'm actually kind of PO'd.
column317: 06x06 - Mafia;Grotti: What?
column318: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: I think you know exactly why, because you were trying to scare me into buying insurance.
column319: 06x06 - Mafia;Grotti: I don't get it. How was I scaring you?
column320: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: I think you knew exactly what you were doing. And frankly I think you were being a total and utter jerk.
column321: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: Whoa. Okay.
column322: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: You suck!
column323: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: Okay that's-
column324: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: And I'm not gonna buy your stupid insurance.
column325: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: That's good, let's wrap it up.
column326: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: How about that? The only person that actually needs insurance is you, if you show your face around here again, got it?
column327: 06x06 - Mafia;Grotti: Look, Michael, when we all calm down here, maybe at some point in the future, you change your mind, why don't you give me a call?
column328: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Doubt it. [disconnects call]
column329: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight and Andy: [relaxing] Oh man.
column330: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: What a tool. [Dwight and Andy exchange looks] What?
column331: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: Next time you look in the mirror, you're gonna be looking at a guy who stood down the mafia!
column332: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: No. What do you mean?
column333: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: We just told you he wasn't mafia, so you wouldn't be scared.
column334: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: What?
column335: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: You successfully backed down the mob!
column336: 06x06 - Mafia;Andy: You made the mafia apologize to you! You made the mafia be polite!
column337: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Oh man. I should be mad at you guys. But I'm not.
column338: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: So I looked him in the eye and I said, "Not today Grotti, Not today. And not tomorrow, and not the next day. Or the day after that. And you can tell all your friends that if I see them, then they're already dead." I said something like that.
column339: 06x06 - Mafia;Dwight: Very close.
column340: 06x06 - Mafia;Oscar: Just to be clear, he backed down an insurance agent from Mutual of Harrisburg.
column341: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Erin?
column342: 06x06 - Mafia;Erin: Yes?
column343: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Coffee?
column344: 06x06 - Mafia;Erin: Okay.
column345: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Not from the kitchen. Stop and Shop. If it's not Stop and Shop, I send it back.
column346: 06x06 - Mafia;Erin: Okay.
column347: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Large. If it's a medium I send it back. If it's an extra large I send it back.
column348: 06x06 - Mafia;Erin: How do you return coffee?
column349: 06x06 - Mafia;Michael: Go. Any questions?
column350: 06x06 - Mafia;Pam: [on phone] Are you kidding me?
column351: 06x06 - Mafia;Kevin: Hi Pam, is Jim there?
column352: 06x06 - Mafia;Pam: Listen our credit card has been cancelled and we have to deal with that, and I really can't handle the fact that you're calling us here!
column353: 06x06 - Mafia;Kevin: Okay, that sounds good. Um, I'll let you go, just -tell Jim, that I said hi.
column354: 06x06 - Mafia;Pam: Oh I will. I will Kevin. I will make that my top priority.
column355: 06x06 - Mafia;Kevin: Cool. Okay. [Pam hangs up] Bye.
column356: 06x06 - Mafia;Kevin: They have no idea what happened.

column11: 06x07 - The Lover;Pam: [goofy voice] Frank and beans!

column15: 06x07 - The Lover;Dwight: Its Jim and Pam, Michael.
column16: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: [gasps] It is?
column17: 06x07 - The Lover;Dwight: Yeah...
column18: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: They're back? Oh! Oh! Oh, Pam! [reaching out with hands at chest level]

column20: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: And oh, Jim...
column21: 06x07 - The Lover;Pam: Hi, Michael.
column22: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: Oh, I haven't see you since my accident that I had when I fell- I fell into the pool of acid, eyes first. Blind guy.
column23: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: Blind-guy McSqueezy. How do I describe it? It is a character I've been workshopping whose lack of vision gets him into all sorts of trouble. The women in my improve class absolutely hate him. [groans]
column24: 06x07 - The Lover;Meredith: So what'd you bring us?

column26: 06x07 - The Lover;Meredith: What else?
column27: 06x07 - The Lover;Pam: That's it.
column28: 06x07 - The Lover;Meredith: Oh, 'cause you spent so much on the wedding.
column29: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: [behind Pam, acting out blind-guy, groaning]
column30: 06x07 - The Lover;Pam: It's good to be home.
column31: 06x07 - The Lover;Dwight: This conversation has two items on the agenda.
column32: 06x07 - The Lover;Jim: Do we have a conversation scheduled?
column33: 06x07 - The Lover;Dwight: Number one, do not leave your things on my desk. It's not some kind of personal pen receptacle for you. I don't care how high they promote you, which brings me to item number two... I never formally congratulated you on your promotion, so I'd just like to say... [high voice, holding up wooden mallard] con-quack-ulations!
column34: 06x07 - The Lover;Jim: Wow, that's... really thoughtful of you, Dwight, thank you.
column35: 06x07 - The Lover;Dwight: [duck voice] You're welcome! [quacks, laughs]
column36: 06x07 - The Lover;Dwight: I inserted a listening device into the belly of the mallard. Now I can observe Jim, trap Jim, and destroy Jim, just like in the Bavarian fairy tale. Only this time, the mallard skins the toad alive. And of course in this version you lose the whole veiled critique of the Kaiser thing.
column37: 06x07 - The Lover;Dwight: I'm sorry to have been bugging you all these years.
column38: 06x07 - The Lover;Jim: It's a real handsome duck.
column39: 06x07 - The Lover;Dwight: Mallard. Okay, I'll get out of your hair.

column41: 06x07 - The Lover;Erin: Hi!
column42: 06x07 - The Lover;Pam: Uh, we brought back some Puerto Rican candy.
column43: 06x07 - The Lover;Erin: Coco Leche! That's my favorite!
column44: 06x07 - The Lover;Pam: Awesome! I'll leave it up here so everyone can enjoy it.
column45: 06x07 - The Lover;Erin: Oh, um, let me just check with Michael first.
column46: 06x07 - The Lover;Pam: [laughs] I think it'll be okay.
column47: 06x07 - The Lover;Erin: [laughs] I think it will too, but I'll just check with him, though.
column48: 06x07 - The Lover;Pam: Great.
column49: 06x07 - The Lover;Erin: Oops, sorry. [slides candy back to Pam] Oops.
column50: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: I have recently taken a lover.
column51: 06x07 - The Lover;Jim: Well, that's great. Congratulations. Who's the lucky lady?
column52: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: Pam's mom.
column53: 06x07 - The Lover;Jim: What?
column54: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: Pam's mom, Helene. Remember from your wedding?
column55: 06x07 - The Lover;Jim: You're messing with me.
column56: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: About what?
column57: 06x07 - The Lover;Jim: You did not have s*x with Pam's mom.
column58: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: Oh, big time.
column59: 06x07 - The Lover;Jim: What kind of car does she drive?
column60: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: She drives a green camry.
column61: 06x07 - The Lover;Jim: [expletive]
column62: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: And the seats go all the way down. All the way down.
column63: 06x07 - The Lover;Jim: Oh my God. [Michael bangs the table] Oh my God.
column64: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: [laughs] What?
column65: 06x07 - The Lover;Jim: Okay, never tell Pam, and secondly-
column66: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: Okay, good, a pact. A pact. Although I may have to break it tonight when Helene and I tell Pam over dinner. You alright?
column67: 06x07 - The Lover;Jim: Oh my God.
column68: 06x07 - The Lover;Toby: [walks in] Hey, Jim.
column69: 06x07 - The Lover;Jim: Not now, Toby, my God!
column70: 06x07 - The Lover;Toby: Oh, Jesus!

column72: 06x07 - The Lover;Toby: What did I do?
column73: 06x07 - The Lover;Jim: Okay, as far as dinner tonight, cancel that, and please, for both our sakes, never, ever, ever see her again.
column74: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: I think you're underestimating Pam. I think more than anything, she wants me to be happy.
column75: 06x07 - The Lover;Jim: No, not more than anything.
column76: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: Okay, I have a good thing with the mom-
column77: 06x07 - The Lover;Jim: Don't call her "the mom."
column78: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: She's right on my way home from work.
column79: 06x07 - The Lover;Jim: Then take a different way home, man!
column80: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: I di- alright, I'll take surface streets, its- the last thing in the world I would want to do is upset Pam.
column81: 06x07 - The Lover;Jim: Okay, so we're good.
column82: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: Yeah.
column83: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: Can you change my dinner reservations from four people to two?
column84: 06x07 - The Lover;Erin: Sure. Oh, is it okay if I put out some candy that Pam brought back from Puerto Rico?
column85: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: Sure. Thanks for asking.
column86: 06x07 - The Lover;Erin: Pam, we're all set. [Pam places candy on Erin's desk] Yum.
column87: 06x07 - The Lover;Jim: Frank and beans!
column88: 06x07 - The Lover;Pam: Frank and beans! [both laugh] So what'd we decide for Michael, the bottle of rum, or the seashell alarm clock?
column89: 06x07 - The Lover;Jim: You know what? Can I have the weekend to decide?
column90: 06x07 - The Lover;Pam: Bottle of rum it is. [takes package out of bag] Alright, shall we?
column91: 06x07 - The Lover;Jim: You know what, I am really slammed, trying to catch up on everything here and I know that Michael's slammed too. So, maybe we should do this when things are a little less crazy.
column92: 06x07 - The Lover;Pam: Come on, it'll take two seconds.
column93: 06x07 - The Lover;Jim: No, it- [high-pitched feedback as Jim starts to leave, feedback changes as he moves, turns over the mallard to see the listening devics, sighs, places mallard back on the desk]
column94: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: [unwraps rum gift] Oh, wow.
column95: 06x07 - The Lover;Pam: [giggles]
column96: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: That is amazing. I feel like a real Puerto Rican.

column99: 06x07 - The Lover;Erin: Fun!
column100: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: Yeah.

column102: 06x07 - The Lover;Michael: Yeah, no, it's nobody.

column4: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Dwight: No, no! You need to come by your sales honorably!

Yeah, I could sure use the money. My cousin, uh, came down with a case of that nasty new goat fungus. Oh, it's just horrific. The doctor says he'd never seen it beard so quickly. Okay.

column8: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Pam: Kevin, you're such a gourmand.

column10: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Pam: Hmm.

column12: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Kevin: I thought that maybe we should do something special for early dinner. One last ultra feast.
column13: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Pam: Mmmm, that sounds great. What are you thinking?

column16: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Pam: No, no. I still have time.
column17: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Pam: I'm having contractions, but they're irregular and far apart. So I'm not really in labor, I'm near labor.

column19: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Pam: If we check in after midnight, I get an extra day to recuperate surrounded by doctors.
column20: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Jim: Not to mention the extra night's sleep in the hospital will be very nice because once we bring the baby home, if it's crying all night, one of us is going to have to take care of it. And I do not plan on helping unless it's a boy.

column29: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Michael: Well, the baby was conceived here, so might as well live here a little bit, too.

column33: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Erin: Ooh, spooky. But why?
column34: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Jim: Because the insurance company only covers two nights.
column35: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Pam: Everything's fine. We have plenty of time.
column36: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Nick: Well, you don't want to wait too long, Pam. Otherwise the baby's going to become a teenager in there and you'll be up all night, from the rock music.
column37: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Michael: Shut up, Nick. What a weird thing to say. Weird I.T. nerd. Don't get revenge on me, nerd.
column38: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Angela: [as Nick looks over at her] What are you looking at?
column39: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Dwight: Ha, nerd.
column40: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Kelly: Did you know that labor can last weeks? Then they take your insides out and they just plop them on a table, and sometimes epidurals don't work, and you can poop yourself.

column43: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Dwight: I want to have a child for business reasons and I want you to be the mother. If you agree, say nothing. If you disagree, say anything... Very well. Let's meet at 4:00 PM at our old meeting spot and bang it out.
column44: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Jim: [after Pam has another contraction] That's seven minutes. Here we go. This is happening. Come on.
column45: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Pam: Hold on, hold on. It isn't midnight yet.
column46: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Jim: Are you serious? Pam.
column47: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Pam: No, the doctor said every five to seven minutes.
column48: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Jim: I... Pam, please.
column49: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Pam: I'm going to be okay, we should really try to make it until midnight.
column50: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Andy: Yeah, no, you really should. Because if your baby's born tomorrow, he's going to have the same birthday as Butt-mud Brooks. My old roommate.
column51: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Pam: Did you hear that? Butt-mud Brooks.
column52: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Jim: Okay, but we are leaving at five minutes apart.
column53: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Pam: Five minutes apart.
column54: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Jim: So, the plan was seven minutes. But we're calling an audible, because that's her call. Because she's the quarterback. I'm just the left tackle who happened to get her pregnant.
column55: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Pam: Okay, stop watching me.
column56: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Jim: Okay, crazy. I think I have some better things to do with my day than worry about you, like sell printers.
column57: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Pam: Mm-hmm.
column58: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Jim: Well not until Friday 20% off toner cartridges, that's a big deal. While we're on the subject, why don't I just run you down to the hospital and we'll just do a quick check?
column59: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Pam: Not until midnight.
column60: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Andy: Guys. Word of advice. Speaking as a former baby. Don't get too hung up on baby names. I was named Walter Jr. after my father until I was about six or so, when my parents changed their minds.
column61: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Erin: I thought you said your younger brother was named Walter Jr.
column62: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Andy: My brother was born, and my parents felt he better exemplified the Walter Jr. name, so they gave it to him. I was given Andrew, which they got out of a baby name book.
column63: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Jim: You know, it's getting real crowded in here. Maybe you guys should all go back to work because the day's not out yet.
column64: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Michael: No, no, no, no, no. You know what? You can't tell us what to do because you are not co-manager anymore.

column67: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Michael: Distractions are good! That means conference room, five minutes! No, no, five seconds! Right now, right now! Conference room! Topic, potpourri! Let's go!

column72: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Andy: Yes! Can anyone do those?

column74: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Jim: [as Pam has another contraction] Oh! Oh, alright. That's a good one.
column75: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Pam: Oh, okay, uh, sorry, guys. Just, um, keep talking.
column76: 06x17/18 - The Delivery (Parts 1&2);Michael: Okay.

column185: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Jo: Hey, all! Cornelius, Bobo, have at it. Nobody let my dogs hump each other. They don't seem to know they're brothers.
column186: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Dwight: Hello, Jo. Welcome. Well, shall we begin?
column187: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Jo: Slow yourself down there. Just like a man. Wants to jump right into it while I still got my socks on. Jim Halpert - the only man that ever turned me down.
column188: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Jim: Well, I don't know about that. Just wasn't for me. But let me assure you, Dwight is firing on all cylinders. Right?
column189: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Jo: Well, some pretty big shoes to fill. I was sorry to hear about Deangelo. He was a good man. Tragic. [Jim coughs]
column190: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Dwight: [does jazz hands, Jo notices and eyes him oddly] Well, what can you do? Life.
column191: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Andy: We have to clean this up now!
column192: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Erin: She had so much -
column193: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Gabe: Hey, guys.
column194: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Erin: Hey.
column195: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Gabe: Hope I'm not interrupting anything.
column196: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Andy: No! [Erin and Andy laugh]
column197: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Gabe: Hey, Andy, did you tell Erin about our conversation earlier when you said you would never want to date her again?
column198: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Andy: Uh...
column199: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Gabe: I just thought that it was so interesting that you promised that.
column200: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Andy: Did I say that earlier? Yes, I did. Because you, Gabe, were crying...
column201: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Gabe: No, I was not.
column202: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Andy: And sobbing uncontrollably. Yes. Uh-huh. You were in hysterics. And my maternal instincts kicked in. Is it actually how I feel? Yes. Or no. That is... between me and my diary.
column203: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Dwight: Oscar, can you print out last year's sale statements?
column204: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Kevin: Hey, Dwight, gimme a back massage.
column205: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Dwight: No, Kevin, come on.
column206: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Kevin: My back is sore, Dwight. Massage it.
column207: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Dwight: Kevin, not now.
column208: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Kevin: Hey, Jo!
column209: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Dwight: Okay, okay. Shh! [Dwight begins rubbing his shoulders]
column210: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Kevin: No, under the jacket.
column211: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Dwight: You're kidding me. [reaches under Kevin's jacket] Oh God, what am I touching? It's moist.
column212: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Kevin: I don't feel anything.
column213: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Dwight: Oh, it's so wet.
column214: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Kevin: Push harder, Dwight.
column215: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Dwight: I can't. I can't push harder!
column216: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Kevin: Go a little higher. There you go. Nope, higher. Higher. [Dwight has positioned his feet on the filing cabinet behind Kevin and is kneading his back horizontally]
column217: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Dwight: Okay, how's that?
column218: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Kevin: Knead it. Knead it like a pizza.
column219: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Dwight: I'm kneading it!
column220: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Kevin: Don't eat it.
column221: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Jo: Dwight! Walk me out. Let's talk soon. And stay on top of these people. You gotta admit it - it's nice to have a little power, eh? How's it feel?
column222: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Dwight: Jo... I accidentally fired a gun in the office today.
column223: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Jo: What?!
column224: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Dwight: I am telling you this because I care too much about this job to be blackmailed into doing it poorly. All I've ever wanted was to be manager here. And if you feel that you cannot promote me over this one accident, I understand. But if you think that extortion is worse -
column225: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Jo: Shooting is worse! Are you kidding me? It's not even in the same - you shot a gun? What is wrong with you?
column226: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Dwight: It was a Beaumont-Adams, if that helps.
column227: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Jo: Beaumont-Adams is a girl's gun. That just makes it plain stupid.
column228: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Dwight: I take full responsibility.
column229: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Jo: Who else would be responsible?
column230: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Dwight: Pam made me put a banana in my holster.
column231: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Pam: You shot a gun off -
column232: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Dwight: Okay. Did I make a mistake? Yes. Do I regret the decision that I made? Yes.
column233: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Jo: Oh, stop asking yourself easy questions so you can look like a genius.
column234: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Dwight: Got it.
column235: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Jo: I love you, Dwight. But you don't fit this job.
column236: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Dwight: [on the verge of tears] Jo, please... I will -
column237: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Jo: No, child. No. It's over. Now I gotta find a replacement for my replacement.
column238: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Jo: You three are my search committee. You're in charge of finding me my next manager. All righty?
column239: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Gabe: Yep.
column240: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Jim: Yep.
column241: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Jo: Till then, we need a new acting manager. Now, who's got the most experience in this office?
column242: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Toby: Uh, well, we probably don't want to go just on seniority.
column243: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Jo: Who is it?
column244: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Jim: Hey, Dwight. What's up?
column245: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Dwight: Shut up.
column246: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Jim: Well, you do know that Jo was right to take the job away from you, right? There's no debating that. But, I will say... in your one week, every single one of the orders went out on time. And I think that is shagadelic, baby. [Dwight sees Creed claiming the desk in the manager's office]
column247: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Angela: [giving Kevin numbers for the copier] Four, one, seven, one...
column248: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Kevin: Another one?
column249: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Darryl and Angela: Yes!
column250: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Angela: Seven, two...
column251: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Oscar: Could you turn the volume down on the beeping?
column252: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Angela: Six, nine, shut up, Oscar. Eight...
column253: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Darryl: Nine first.
column254: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Angela: Nine, eight, five...
column255: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Kevin: Thank you.
column256: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Angela: Three, zero, zero. Again, zero. Four, six...
column257: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Kevin: Nice.
column258: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Angela: Two, one...
column259: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Kevin: Oh, I hit three. I hit three.
column260: 07x24 - Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager;Angela: God!

column1: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Creed: [drives up to the entrance of the building, his license plate reads "NEW MGR"] It's a beautiful morning at Dunder-Mifflin, or as I like to call it, Great Bratton. [gets out of car, tosses his keys toward a nonexistent valet parker] Keep it running.
column2: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Creed: Do I love being manager?... I love my kids. I love real estate. [slowly getting more excited] I love ceramics. I love my job. I-I love wrestling.
column3: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Creed: [to Jordan] Find out what language this is. [speaking in strange language]
column4: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Creed: [running a meeting in the conference room] Okay, team building! On this side of the room, Stanley, Phyllis, Jim, Ted, Elroy, [camera switches to show only Meredith and Kevin have attended the meeting, Jim walks by and sees this] and this side of the room, Pam, Meredith, Phyllis, Creed...
column5: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: He never called a meeting.
column6: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Creed: [pointing at a whiteboard with BOBODDY written on the left side, vertically] BO-BODDY! BO-BODDY. What does the first "B" stand for?
column7: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Pam: What are we doing?
column8: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Creed: We're making acronyms. Okay! What does the first "B" stand for?
column9: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Kevin: Um... Business!
column10: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Creed: I like it! Business! Good, Kevin! [writes after the first B, I, Z, N, U...] All right! The "O"...
column11: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Pam: We need a new manager.
column12: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: [conducting interview] Your paper experience is very interesting. Do you think you could use that experience to inform decisions here?
column13: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Fred Henry: Absolutely--I, yes. In fact, I actually have a three-step plan that I believe could effectively double your profits.
column14: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: Really?
column15: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Fred: Yeah.
column16: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: [waiting for Fred to continue] ...What is it?
column17: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Fred: Nice try.
column18: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Toby: I'm sorry, what is your three-step plan?
column19: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Fred: Well, I mean, I can't just hand you my plan. I mean, if you guys give me the job, then, then you'll get the plan.
column20: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Gabe: Well... it's an interview, and we don't know that you really have the plan.
column21: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Fred: [speaking faster] Well, I'm not gonna just make up that I have a plan. I got a plan. Believe me, you guys want it. You're in paper, right?
column22: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Gabe: How would we know that, if you don't...
column23: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: You could just be saying it to get the job.
column24: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Fred: I guess I could be, if I was... who would do that?
column25: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: How about this. Why don't you give us a part of the plan, and that way we know you have it.
column26: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Fred: Tell you what. I'll give you part three of part two. Not gonna give you a whole part.
column27: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: Okay.
column28: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Fred: Color-code sent documents, TM.
column29: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: Did you just trademark that...
column30: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Toby: [confused] W-What?
column31: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Fred: That's a verbal trademark. That's an agreement.
column32: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: We are the Search Committee, hand-picked by our CEO, and tasked to find this branch's new manager. Not everyone we meet will be good, but someone's bound to be, right? [Andy, Kelly, and Darryl are each dressed up in suits for their interviews, Andy is also wearing an "Andy for Manager?" pin on his jacket] And, to be honest, I think a lot of the decent candidates are right here in-house, so, I'm not too worried. But I'm really excited to spend a lot of time with Toby and Gabe. [quietly] Did you know that Gabe's last name was Lewis? I had no idea.
column33: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Stanley: [in elevator with Phyllis and Darryl, all three are smiling, to Darryl] Good morning.
column34: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Darryl: Good morning.
column35: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Phyllis: [also to Darryl] Good morning.
column36: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Darryl: Good morning.
column37: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Phyllis: Did you have a nice drive in?
column38: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Darryl: I did.
column39: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Darryl: I have a solid relationship with Jo, the company's owner. I have management experience. I have a good friendship with Jim, the head of the Search Committee, and it doesn't hurt that I'm... [in Oprah-like sing-song voice] bla-aaack!
column40: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Andy: [puts up a poster in the break room with "IF YOU ARE ON THE SEARCH COMMITTEE PLEASE CONSIDER ANDY" on it in bold lettering]
column41: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Erin: [commenting on the poster] It's good. I really hope you get it!
column42: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Andy: The manager job? Nah, I'm barely interested. I just can't not go for it. You know, it's not the Bernard way. We give it the old college try, and then, in defeat, we show grace.
column43: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Erin: Still, I'd really like to see this office with you in the boss's chair.
column44: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Andy: Don't even... [getting really happy and excited] EEEHHHH!!!!
column45: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Erin: You in the boss's chair!
column46: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Andy: EEEHHH!! No. Hehe.
column47: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Andy: In my family, you don't really go out and get things. If you want something, you write it on a list, and then the housekeeper goes out and gets it, on Wednesdays and Fridays. So, I don't know, I guess you could say this job is on my list, and... [awkwardly smiling] we'll see what Rosa comes back with.
column48: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Erin: [checks to see that she is alone with Phyllis] Did you hear anything?
column49: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Phyllis: Oh, I'm sure they'll let us know when they get the results. [Erin crosses fingers and smiles excitedly]
column50: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Phyllis: It turns out that Erin was born in the basic time and region that I gave away a child.
column51: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Erin: So, Phyllis might be my mom. I mean, the chances are tiny, but...
column52: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Phyllis: But, probably not, I mean, it was a big year for babies. Porky's had come out.
column53: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Erin: Yeah. I'm sure I was just another Porky's baby.
column54: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Phyllis: Mm.
column55: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Erin: But why not find out.
column56: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Phyllis: Yeah.
column57: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Pam: [to Dwight, who is reading the want ads] Should you really be so blatant about that?
column58: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Dwight: They won't make me manager, and I won't settle for anything less. I've gone about as far as I can here. That's obvious. Time to take my talents elsewhere.
column59: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Pam: Are you really going to apply for work at Scranton Breadworks?
column60: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Dwight: Bread is the paper of the food industry. You write your sandwich on it.
column61: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Warren Buffett: Can you do any better on salary?
column62: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: Unfortunately, that range is set at corporate.
column63: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Warren: What about mileage when I use my car? I mean, gas ain't cheap, you know.
column64: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: Heh. We think that 25 cents a mile is pretty generous.
column65: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Warren: How about 27? And uh, when I make long-distance calls, will they be monitored or is it on the honor system?
column66: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Angela: [on phone] Okay. [hangs up, smiling] How odd, a very unusual phone call from the Senator's office. The Senator wants me to have lunch with him at The Botanical Gardens.
column67: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Kevin: The Botanical Gardens, Scranton's hidden gem. Don't eat any berries you don't recognize.
column68: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Toby: How will your experience selling refinery equipment translate to our smaller scale here?
column69: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Robert California: You don't work in sales, do you.
column70: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Toby: Uh... Human Resources.
column71: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Robert: You see, I sit across from a man. I see his face. I see his eyes. Now, does it matter if he wants a hundred dollars of paper or a hundred million dollars of deep-sea drilling equipment? Don't be a fool. He wants respect. He wants love. He wants to be younger. He wants to be attractive. There is no such thing as a product. Don't ever think there is. There is only... s*x. Everything... is s*x. You understand that what I'm telling you is a universal truth,... Toby.
column72: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Toby: Yes.
column73: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Gabe: Okay, I-I am, I'm almost a little concerned that you might be overqualified for the position. [Robert and Gabe chuckle at this, then Gabe stops chuckling] Do you, um, do you think that you are?
column74: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Robert: Do I look like someone who would waste my own time?
column75: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Gabe: No. [Robert then nods his head at Jim]
column76: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: Can you... [seems intimidated, clears throat] You are a man of great confidence. Could you speak a little more to that, and, what the role of confidence... would be... in a dialogue with a subordinate?
column77: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Robert: Will you be heard? Will you have a voice? Will I steamroll over you? Do you feel heard right now, Jim? Do you have a voice, right now? You can answer me.
column78: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: Yes.
column79: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Robert: That was your choice, not mine. The fallacy is that it is up to the steamroller. It is up to the object... whether it will be flattened or not, and I can tell from the small interaction we've had already, you won't be flattened by anybody. Do you agree with me, Jim?
column80: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: Yes.
column81: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Robert: [more emphatically than Jim] Yes. You do. [nods at the Search Committee, then looks over at the camera with a smirk on his face]
column82: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: [Robert leaves the conference room and looks at the others in the office as he grins at the camera and leaves] He creeps me out. [Toby nods] But, I think he might be a genius.
column83: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Andy: [Jim points at Darryl to be the next interviewee] Good luck, Darryl.
column84: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Darryl: [pats Andy on the back] Thank you.
column85: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Darryl: Think about it! What other mammal, besides humans, drinks the milk of another mammal? I mean, you don't see a bear drinking raccoon milk.
column86: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: [Jim and Gabe laugh, Toby smiles and nods] Oh.
column87: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Darryl: So this is cool. I think we make a good fit. [stands up]
column88: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Gabe: Oh? Uh... we haven't started the interview yet. Were you--were you joking?
column89: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Darryl: Uh... [looks at camera] yes?! I was. [sits back down] Little joke!
column90: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Toby: So, how would you go about settling interpersonal conflicts within the office?
column91: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Darryl: I thought that was your job.
column92: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Toby: Well, it's one of my strengths, but it's the manager's job.
column93: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: Well, for instance, how did you deal with it when two warehouse guys got into a fight?
column94: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Darryl: I'll answer that, Jim. I would use it as an opportunity to teach, uh, about actions... and consequences... of actions. [Jim and Gabe stare at Darryl]
column95: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Darryl: [noticing Erin in the background leading a black man dressed in a suit through the office] Who's that?
column96: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: [ignoring Darryl's question] So I think all we need is a resume, and we'll be good right?
column97: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Darryl: I... I just thought you knew me.
column98: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: Yeah, it's no big deal, just something that looks like that. [shows Darryl a resume] Cool? [goes to put the resume away]
column99: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Darryl: Let me... [Jim shows him the resume again, Darryl looks at it a little longer this time] Oh. Cool. [Jim gives Darryl a thumbs-up, then looks at the camera as Darryl gets up to leave]
column100: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Merv Bronte: [at the cafe on the first floor] Did, uh, you just interview?
column101: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Robert: Ohh, unfortunately, yes.
column102: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Merv: What do you mean?
column103: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Robert: That business can't attract anyone. It's awful up there. Those people seem like they're in prison, waiting out life sentences in a... dying industry.
column104: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Merv: Place must be horrible. I don't know if I want this job. [gets on elevator]
column105: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Merv: [in elevator] Well, if I get this job offer, and then I know that I'm gonna take it, and if I take it, I know that I'm never gonna quit, and then 25 years are gonna go by and... I'm gonna die here.
column106: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Dwight: What makes you feel qualified to judge a place after a mere interview? [Robert stares at Dwight] What are you doing..? [Dwight sits up abruptly] Stop trying to figure me out.
column107: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Robert: I just did.
column108: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Dwight: You can't.
column109: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Robert: It's done.
column110: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Dwight: No, it's not.
column111: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Robert: I know you now, your nature. I'm done. Not worth continuing. [at the same time, Dwight says[/b]: You don't know me! Anything about me! Get out of my head!]
column112: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Dwight: Stop trying to figure me out. [Robert turns to ignore Dwight] Do you even know anything about paper? How it's made?

column310: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jordan: [laughs] Okay.
column311: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Pam: Hello! This is... the client.
column312: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Creed: It's Creed. FYI, I'm starting my own paper company, looking to poach some chumps, you in?
column313: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Pam: Yes.
column314: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Creed: Hehehe, cool. Let's keep this on the QT, okay? I uh, I don't want you to be a dead mamma jamma.
column315: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Pam: Great.
column316: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Creed: All right, thank you, bye-bye.
column317: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Pam: Thank you, bye-bye.
column318: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Erin: [knocks and enters] Jo, you have one more candidate. He's a burn victim.
column319: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jo: Huh?
column320: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Erin: [motions toward her face] He's all messed up. I can tell him to get lost if you want.
column321: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jo: No, send him in. [to Search Committee] Who is this?
column322: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Gabe: I have no idea.
column323: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: [seeing Dwight wearing sunglasses and whose face and hands are completely covered in gauze] Oh, I know this guy. [Dwight awkwardly hands copies of his resume to the Search Committee] Hello! Mr. "Soo-ven-yay." Mr. "Jacques Soo-ven-yay." Nice to meet you. It says here you're French. [Dwight nods] So you worked at your last job for 15 years as Assistant to the Regional Manager.
column324: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Dwight: [mumbling through the gauze] Assistant Regional Manager.
column325: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: Assistant to the Regional Manager.
column326: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Dwight: [again] Assistant Regional Manager.
column327: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: What is it?
column328: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Dwight: [in a cheesy French accent] Assistant Regional Manager.
column329: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: Oh, that's my mistake, sorry about that. The last paper company you worked for burned to the ground? And all because they wouldn't hire a manager who lived and breathed paper? That's a travesty.
column330: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jo: I want to talk to Dwight Schrute for a second. I want to ask him a question. [Gabe gets up to leave] If he isn't here in sixty seconds...
column331: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Dwight: Uhh. Wait. Wait! No. Stop! Stop. Jo... [takes off sunglasses and reveals his face] It's me. I'm Dwight.
column332: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: [looks extremely confused] No. No! Wait, but, I mean, you're Dwight, and then... he's the... [trails off]
column333: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Dwight: [whispers] Yeah.
column334: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: [looks astonished] Ohhhh!
column335: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Gabe: Very unprofessional, "Jacques." Or, should I say, Dwight.
column336: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jo: Let's just say I had hired this Jack Souvenir. Then what?
column337: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Dwight: I would have dressed this way every day, legally changed my name, learned French sign language, shown up, and been the best damn branch manager you'd ever seen!
column338: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jo: All that for this job.
column339: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Dwight: Yes.
column340: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jo: That's f***ing crazy. [Jo and Dwight both smile] Get outta here. [Dwight leaves] What a nutjob.
column341: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: This guy was good. Although, he did keep saying that he needed two weeks off right at the beginning for a trip to the finger lakes. Seriously. Every five minutes, he was like, "just making sure the finger lakes thing is clear."
column342: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jo: Okay, it's fun to talk about the rejects, but uh, who's got ya excited?
column343: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: Finger Lakes guy is good. Darryl is also very good.
column344: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jo: Who's this fella? Went to Cornell. What's wrong with him?
column345: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Gabe: How much time do you have? Sales ability? None. Integrity? See sales ability. [makes a "zero" hand gesture]
column346: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jo: And that's your unbiased opinion.
column347: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Gabe: Yes, it is.
column348: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jo: So it's not relevant that he took the receptionist away from you?
column349: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Gabe: Oh, Jo. Jo, I'm disappointed in you. Some people let personal things into the workpl-. Is she with him? Because I thought that she was...
column350: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jo: Gabe...ugh... you got all close to these people. Got involved in their lives. Let's get you back to Florida. We'll figure out something for you.
column351: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Gabe: That sounds like a promotion!
column352: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jo: It's not. Let's get Kelly in here to take his place.
column353: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: Um... why Kelly?
column354: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jo: 'Cause Gabe's tall and weak. She's short and strong. I'm doing an opposites thing.
column355: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: Okay.
column356: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jo: How'd my girl Nellie do?
column357: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: Oh, I didn't know you knew her?
column358: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jo: She didn't mention it?
column359: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: No.
column360: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jo: Integrity move. I like it.
column361: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: You know, she also gave me a reason to think that maybe she wasn't a good fit.
column362: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jo: Well, I'm not saying you must hire her. If you find someone who's clearly a fit, then fine. Just make sure they fit real good. No more manager turnover. Don't mess this up, Jim. And give Dwight an interview. I like a little bit of crazy.
column363: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Erin: [hiding under desk, raises a sock puppet up, talking in high-pitched voice] Ahh!
column364: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Oscar: Erin, what are you doing?
column365: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Erin: I've been turned into a puppet!
column366: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Oscar: Okay. [walks away]
column367: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Kevin: [giggling, walks to Erin's desk] Look at the puppet! Hi, puppet! Who are you?
column368: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Erin: I went to drop off the FedEx forms and an evil witch named Angela turned me into a puppet!
column369: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Kevin: [giggles] Yeah. Low blow, puppet.
column370: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Erin: And there's only one thing that can change me back into a real girl.
column371: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Kevin: It's good. It's just that I wish the puppets would talk more about the alphabet. Not for me... but, if any kids are watching... A, B, and so forth. You know,... M-N-L-O, P... F...
column372: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Erin: [as sock puppet] I need the most special thing in the office.
column373: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Dwight: Silence?
column374: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Erin: A date with the best salesman... Andy Bernard! [Andy walks over to Erin's desk]
column375: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Andy: Hey, Erin.
column376: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Erin: [gets up] Oh.
column377: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Andy: Where'd you learn how to puppet like that?
column378: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Erin: [shrugs] I've done it all my life.
column379: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Andy: Listen, I'm really flattered, but I don't think we should.
column380: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Andy: Erin's my best friend in this office, hands down, but... when she asked me out, I just didn't have that feeling, you know? [clip jumps ahead] Aren't there some things that you really want to like, but you just can't... seem to like it, like, Mad Men... or football... [clips jumps ahead] Let's not forget, Erin chose Gabe over me. That happened. I'm not going to apologize for getting over her, okay? I'm sorry. [clip jumps ahead] I would go for someone who's more... she's great, though.
column381: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Angela: [loudly] Stanley, I won't be able to invite everyone to the wedding, because we want to keep it to 350.
column382: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Stanley: I'll get over it.
column383: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Angela: I mean, we just have to see how many Senators and members of Congress want to attend, before we can open it up to regular people. Pam, you know how you and Jim did your ironic wedding? [Pam looks confused] Do you still have the plans for the dream wedding that you couldn't afford?
column384: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Pam: That was our dream wedding.
column385: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Angela: Niagara Falls? Pregnant? That was your dream? Pork medallions?
column386: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Pam: [looks over at Oscar, who is quietly watching this happen] I hope... you have a very beautiful wedding, Angela.
column390: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: Thank you, Mr. Schnoot. [closes his binder] We will let you know.
column391: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Dwight: You have to interview me...
column392: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: I just did. The answer to that one question told me everything I need to know.
column393: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Dwight: I demand more questions!
column394: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: [ignoring Dwight] All right, guys, good day, a lot of candidates. Let's discuss.
column395: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Dwight: Okay! If you're not going to interview me, then I'll do it.
column397: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Dwight: What will be your first priority? I will have seven first priorities. Safety, profits, fostering a community of self-reliance and entrepreneurship, listening, respect for human life, bolstering our public image, and... [chuckles] getting everyone home on time. Dwight, let me be frank. In an accident that no one can blame you for, an antique gun was discharged while you were acting manager. How are we ever to trust you again? [whispering] That's a great question. [Jim nods] I am going to institute a strict no-firearms policy for this office that extends to myself as well. Wow. All of my concerns are disappearing.
column399: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Dwight: Thank you. [clears throat and gets up] You'll be hearing from us shortly, Mr. Schrute, and I think you're gonna like the call you're going to receive. [smiles] Oh, come on. I'm just happy that I got this meeting. [leaves]
column400: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: Well, that was quick.
column401: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Kelly: [sighs] Very, very interesting. And you know what? I'm impressed.
column402: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: He's not a real candidate.
column403: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Kelly: I don't know, Jim, 'cause, makes me think about something my grandfather used to say, which is that, sometimes, the hand that jumps out of the grave and grabs you around the throat; that is the hand that you want on the wheel.
column404: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: You took the deal.
column405: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Kelly: Yeah, it was a great deal.
column407: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Kelly: I don't know. Dwight seems like a great leader to me, and I look forward to the personal perks that he promised me privately. What do you think, Toby?
column408: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Toby: Well, we could try him out for a little while... [Jim drops his pen, looks exasperated] and if it doesn't work out, you know, maybe one of us could, you know, step in...
column409: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: What is happening right now?
column410: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Phyllis: Is it true that you're making Dwight the manager?
column411: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: No, why would you think that?
column412: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Phyllis: He and Kelly said, then they pre-fired me.
column413: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: Okay. [walks out of conference room] Okay, guys, just so you all know, no decision has been made, and Dwight is definitely not the boss.
column414: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Kelly: That is correct. Actually, Dwight is not the manager yet.
column415: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: No, no, no. Not ever, 'cause that's not gonna happen.
column416: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Dwight: Well, it's not entirely up to you, is it? Seems to me like someone's getting a little power-mad.
column417: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: Am I the only one who remembers what he did when he was in charge? I feel like I'm going a little bit crazy.
column418: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Andy: Tuna... You're completely sane.
column420: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Andy: Who do you like for the job? Is there anyone who maybe was a little underwhelming at first, but now seems like a safe, if not slightly unexciting, choice?
column421: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: Okay, seems like everybody has an opinion. So, who else? Anybody?
column422: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Kevin: Do you mean it? Anybody? Are you sure?
column423: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: [while sighing] I suppose I am.
column424: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Kevin: Okay... well what do 'I' want in a manager?... let me see. [walks slowly across the office] what do 'I' want?...
column425: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Oscar: I don't think he meant, that--
column426: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Kevin: So now anyone gets to talk at any times?
column428: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Kevin: What do 'I' want?... I'm looking for someone... who... [smiles] Everyone is listening to me. [Dwight looks at the camera, annoyed]
column431: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Oscar: I think it should be Darryl.
column433: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Dwight: What a surprise! Minorities sticking together.
column434: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Oscar: Kelly's on your side.
column435: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Kelly: I'm sorry, is that all you think of me? A minority? I am so much more than that. I am a dancer, I'm a singer, I'm a fashion designer.
column436: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Andy: Whoever it is, I think they should be lame. [Stanley shakes his head and rolls his eyes] Kind a a non-threatening, moderate personality.
column437: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Ryan: I want an outsider.
column438: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: Perfect. There are several outside candidates that we think would be really-
column439: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Ryan: No, I mean an outsider. Like someone on the margins of society, who doesn't see things the way we do, like a homeless person.
column440: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Pam: A homeless person. Really? A homeless person.
column441: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Ryan: No, you're right, Pam, let's just leave him to the welfare system and let that handle it.
column442: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Pam: No, I want you to say that you think the 'best' person to be our new manager is a homeless person.
column443: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Ryan: Let me guess who you want, Pam. Rachael Ray? The ladies of The View?
column444: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Ryan: I got away with... everything, under the last boss, and it wasn't good for me, at all. So, I want guidance. I want leadership. But don't just, like, boss me around, you know? Like, lead me. Lead me... when I'm in the mood... to be led.
column445: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Meredith: I just want, for once, a smart, professional, decisive, well-hung man in his forties.
column447: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Meredith: Okay, fine. Uhh, the guy with a tiny pen1s. Are you happy? [sarcastically] Let's hire that guy! [Jim looks speechless]
column448: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Andy: She may have a point there... would a small pen1s work? Small-to-moderate.
column449: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Gabe: [walks in] Gotta catch a plane.
column450: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Pam: Ohh, hey Gabe, I'm sorry, we... we didn't get you a cake or anything. We're gonna miss you.
column451: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Gabe: Oh, well I'm still the corporate liaison to the branch.
column452: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Kelly: You are not leaving without giving me a hug. [hugs Gabe] Ughh.
column453: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Gabe: Okay, you know what, you don't need to make that sound.
column454: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Kelly: I'm sorry! You were just a lot bonier than I thought you were gonna be!
column455: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Gabe: There are plenty of people who love touching me. [camera zooms to Ryan, who looks at the camera, extremely skeptical] I'm a terrific hugger. I've been with a bunch of girls where that's basically all they want to do. I will see you all soon.
column457: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);All: [various] Good luck! Goodbye! Good luck at your new job.
column459: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Dwight: We're gonna miss you, Gabe. [Gabe leaves]
column460: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Andy: [stands up] Uh, listen up. Listen up, ladies. I want the job. There, I said it. I'm educated. I'm capable. I like all of you... and I won't make any changes.
column461: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Erin: I see it. [nods and smiles] I see it like I see a mountain that I'm standing in front of [voice cracks] and facing, and I'm like...
column462: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Phyllis: Yeah. [Oscar looks confused] Yeah, Andy would be wonderful as boss. Erin made a good point. [brushes Erin's hair with her hand]
column463: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Phyllis: No, we're not related. I got the call. But... I'll tell her some other day. [smiles]
column464: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: What about Darryl? We can all agree that he's a stand-up guy, right?
column465: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Angela: Well, let me be clear. I only speak for myself, and not myself and the Senator. I think we have some wonderful candidates, and there's a great, lively debate here, but let's think about-
column466: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Toby: No, no,... no. Sorry. We cut Kevin off for the same thing. You have to have something to say, if you talk. [Angela rolls her eyes and stops talking]
column468: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Darryl: [enters the office with his daughter, who runs in and hugs Jim] Jada, no, no, no, Jada, what are you doing? [Jim looks knowingly at the camera] Oh. So sorry, guys. I hope my family didn't disrupt your meeting.
column469: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jada: Daddy, are these the people who are making you manager?
column470: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Darryl: [sighs] Maybe, sweetheart. Single dad. Challenges.
column471: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jada: I don't know if he'd be a good manager [Jim shakes his head and looks wide-eyed at Darryl], but he's a really great dad!
column472: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Darryl: Okay, shush it. This was a mistake. Let's go. [Darryl and Jada leave, Ryan slowly shakes his head]
column473: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Phyllis: It seems like we all know enough to vote. Should we just vote now?
column474: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: What? No, no, it's not a vote.
column475: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Phyllis: Then what was this all about?
column476: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: I don't know. This conversation really got away from me.
column477: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Kelly: I don't care. They can just vote.
column478: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Jim: No, they can't. That's not how this is gonna work. [exhales] We're going in this room, we're going to have a meeting. We're gonna make a recommendation to Jo, and she's gonna give you her recommendation on Monday. Okay? [to Kelly and Toby, as they re-enter the conference room] What the hell happened out there? [Kevin tries to follow, but the door is closed on him]
column479: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Andy: Sometimes you hear about people failing upwards. I think I'm about to do that.
column480: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Nellie: This job? Oh, yeah, I'll get it. Jo's an old friend. I think... I'm her best friend. She's not my best friend.
column481: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Darryl: Every day I have a blueberry muffin. Today, I did not have a blueberry muffin. Should have had the blueberry muffin... especially considering how incredibly superstitious I am.
column482: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Fred: No, I've never been more sure of anything in my life. I will be the new boss of... [looks back to glance at lobby directory] Vance Refrigeration.
column483: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Merv: Honestly, I think I... I sabotaged myself. It's like I'm afraid of being happy. Case in point... I was supposed to start another job today.
column484: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Robert: [chuckles] I will get offered the job. That's a... call I've received many times. The slight hopefulness in their voice, the pregnant pause... while they wait to hear my response, and then... my response.
column485: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Finger Lakes Guy: [geeky voice] I want the job. I really do. It's just, the rest of my family's in the Finger Lakes right now. I'm supposed to be in the Finger Lakes right now. I told them I was on a hike; snuck away to do this interview. I gotta get back pretty soon; they'll worry. People disappear in the Finger Lakes.
column486: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Dwight: I will run this branch, or I will destroy this branch, or... [shrugs] I don't know. Something always works out. [leaves]
column487: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Creed: You remind me so much of my fourth-biggest client.
column488: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Pam: [in high-pitched, damsel-like voice] Is that right?
column489: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Creed: I think you two should meet.
column491: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Creed: Hey Jordana! Patch my ninth- and fourth-biggest clients together. [Pam puts down phone and picks it back up]
column492: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Pam as "fourth-biggest client": [in a comedic male voice] Hello!
column493: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Pam as "ninth-biggest client": [in high-pitched, damsel-like voice] Hello!
column494: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Pam as "fourth-biggest client": Hi, how are ya? [Erin looks amused, Stanley and Phyllis look at Pam, confused]
column495: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Pam as "ninth-biggest client": Ohho! I'm good! Don't you just love paper, and things about paper!
column496: 07x25/26 - Search Committee (Parts 1&2);Pam as "fourth-biggest client": Hey, are you single? This seems like a love connection to me!

column1: 08x01 - The List;Oscar: Oh, for God's sake. [notices Erin planking on parking lot curb]
column2: 08x01 - The List;Oscar: Planking is a very stupid and dangerous trend. Basically, you lie like a plank in weird places. That's it. Sometimes you get run over. Welcome to the Internet.
column3: 08x01 - The List;Erin: Planking is one of those things where, eh, you either get it or you don't.  And I don't.  But I am so excited to be a part of it.
column4: 08x01 - The List;Andy: [exiting elevator] After you my good sir.
column5: 08x01 - The List;Dwight: No, I insist.
column6: 08x01 - The List;Andy: I insist.
column7: 08x01 - The List;Jim: The Search Committee finally decided, after a lot of deliberation, on Robert California... for the manager position. Who took one look around and left.  He drove down to Florida and convinced Joe to make him CEO... CEO... her own job. He talked her out of her own job. And I don't really know how someone does that. But, anyway, then the position was his to fill.   And he chose...
column8: 08x01 - The List;Andy: [drumroll with hands] I... it's unbelievable. True, I may have been the second choice, but I was the first-choice's first choice. And, about Dwight, I sensed that he might have some resentment about not getting the job so I sat him down and we had a talk. And I told him, "I need a really strong number two. column170: 09x01 - The New Guys;Andy: Well it's official. Old Dwight is lame and New Dwight is cool.

column177: 09x01 - The New Guys;Dwight: Slack lining, please. Untie that rope, give it to a couple of pig-tailed school girls, let them start jumping with it while chanting a rhyme and giggling about boys. Doesn't seem so macho now, does it? It's a jump rope!
column178: 09x01 - The New Guys;Pam: Dwight!
column179: 09x01 - The New Guys;Dwight: Pam? Hey come up here, up the ladder. Come on.
column180: 09x01 - The New Guys;Pam: [sees trapeze contraption] What are you doing?
column181: 09x01 - The New Guys;Dwight: Come here, I'll show you.
